title.ko: 한국 기후부, 글로벌녹색성장기구와 녹색성장 협력 확대
title.sv: Svenskt eller koreanskt samarbete om grön tillväxt breddas
title.en: Korea expands green growth cooperation with GGGI

summary.ko:
기후에너지환경부는 튀르키예 안탈리아에서 열린 유엔기후변화협약 당사국총회에서 글로벌녹색성장기구와 양해각서를 체결했다고 밝혔어요. 양 기관은 기존의 녹색성장 사업에 더해 에너지전환, 수소경제, 순환경제 등으로 협력 범위를 넓히기로 했어요.

특히 파리협정 이행을 지원하고 개발도상국의 녹색성장 계획 수립을 함께 추진해요. 협력 방식도 기술지원과 정책자문, 공적개발원조 사업 등으로 다양화할 계획이에요.

글로벌녹색성장기구는 2012년 한국 주도로 출범해 서울에 본부를 두고 있어요. 김성환 기후부 장관은 개발도상국의 탄소중립 이행을 돕는 실질적인 성과로 이어지도록 하겠다고 말했어요.
summary.sv:
Klimatdepartementet meddelar att man har undertecknat ett samarbetsavtal med Globala institutet för grön tillväxt under ett klimatmöte i Turkiet. Organisationerna ska utöka samarbetet till att omfatta energiomställning, vätgasekonomi och cirkulär ekonomi.

Man ska bland annat stödja genomförandet av Parisavtalet och hjälpa utvecklingsländer med grön tillväxt. Samarbetet ska ske genom tekniskt stöd, policyrådgivning och biståndsprojekt.

GGGI är en internationell organisation med huvudkontor i Seoul som startade på koreanskt initiativ år 2012. Minister Kim Sung-hwan säger att man vill nå konkreta resultat som hjälper utvecklingsländer att nå koldioxidneutralitet.
summary.en:
The climate ministry announced that it signed a memorandum of understanding with the Global Green Growth Institute during a climate conference in Turkey. The two organizations agreed to expand their cooperation to include energy transition, the hydrogen economy, and the circular economy.

They will particularly support the implementation of the Paris Agreement and help developing countries establish green growth plans. The cooperation will also diversify through technical support, policy advice, and aid projects.

GGGI is an international organization based in Seoul that was launched under Korea's leadership in 2012. Climate Minister Kim Sung-hwan said he hopes this will lead to practical results that help developing countries achieve carbon neutrality.

title.text: 한국 기후부, 글로벌녹색성장기구와 녹색성장 협력 확대
title.en: South Korea's Ministry of Climate expands green growth cooperation with the Global Green Growth Institute
title.grammar: A typical news headline structure dropping final sentence copulas or predicates, relying on noun-ending modifiers.

body.text: 기후에너지환경부는 튀르키예 안탈리아에서 열린 유엔기후변화협약 당사국총회에서 글로벌녹색성장기구와 양해각서를 체결했다고 밝혔어요.
body.en: The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment announced that it has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Global Green Growth Institute at the UN Climate Change Conference of the Parties held in Antalya, Turkey.
body.grammar: Complex sentence embedding an indirect quotation (-다고 밝혔어요) and multiple modifiers describing the event and location.

기후에너지환경부는.en: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (topic)

유엔기후변화협약.en: UN Framework Convention on Climate Change

당사국총회에서.en: at the Conference of the Parties

body.text: 양 기관은 기존의 녹색성장 사업에 더해 에너지전환, 수소경제, 순환경제 등으로 협력 범위를 넓히기로 했어요.
body.en: The two organizations decided to broaden the scope of cooperation to energy transition, the hydrogen economy, and the circular economy, in addition to existing green growth projects.
body.grammar: Uses 에 더해 ('in addition to') and the decision ending -기로 하다.

body.text: 특히 파리협정 이행을 지원하고 개발도상국의 녹색성장 계획 수립을 함께 추진해요.
body.en: In particular, they will support the implementation of the Paris Agreement and jointly promote the establishment of green growth plans for developing countries.
body.grammar: Uses the connective form -고 to link actions and nouns like 이행 ('implementation') and 수립 ('establishment').

body.text: 협력 방식도 기술지원과 정책자문, 공적개발원조 사업 등으로 다양화할 계획이에요.
body.en: They also plan to diversify the forms of cooperation through technical support, policy consultation, and official development assistance projects.
body.grammar: Uses the future-oriented planning ending -ㄹ 계획이에요.

body.text: 글로벌녹색성장기구는 2012년 한국 주도로 출범해 서울에 본부를 두고 있어요.
body.en: The Global Green Growth Institute was launched in 2012 at South Korea's initiative and is headquartered in Seoul.
body.grammar: Combines passive/launched verbs with continuous state endings like -고 있어요.

body.text: 김성환 기후부 장관은 개발도상국의 탄소중립 이행을 돕는 실질적인 성과로 이어지도록 하겠다고 말했어요.
body.en: Climate Minister Kim Sung-hwan said he will ensure it leads to practical results that help developing countries achieve carbon neutrality.
body.grammar: Features nested relative clauses modifying 'practical results' (성과) and indirect speech endings (-다고 말했어요).

title.text: Svenskt eller koreanskt samarbete om grön tillväxt breddas
title.en: Swedish or Korean cooperation on green growth is being broadened
title.grammar: Uses passive voice (-s ending: 'breddas') indicating an action performed on the subject.

body.text: Klimatdepartementet meddelar att man har undertecknat ett samarbetsavtal med Globala institutet för grön tillväxt under ett klimatmöte i Turkiet.
body.en: The Climate Department announces that it has signed a cooperation agreement with the Global Green Growth Institute during a climate meeting in Turkey.
body.grammar: Employs subordinate clauses introduced by 'att' and the reflexive/passive past participle construction 'har undertecknat'.

body.text: Organisationerna ska utöka samarbetet till att omfatta energiomställning, vätgasekonomi och cirkulär ekonomi.
body.en: The organizations are to expand the cooperation to include energy transition, hydrogen economy, and circular economy.
body.grammar: Uses the infinitive marker 'att' after 'omfatta' in a prepositional phrase structure ('till att omfatta').

body.text: Man ska bland annat stödja genomförandet av Parisavtalet och hjälpa utvecklingsländer med grön tillväxt.
body.en: They will, among other things, support the implementation of the Paris Agreement and help developing countries with green growth.
body.grammar: Uses the adverbial phrase 'bland annat' meaning 'among other things' and compound noun formation ('genomförandet').

body.text: Samarbetet ska ske genom tekniskt stöd, policyrådgivning och biståndsprojekt.
body.en: The cooperation will take place through technical support, policy advice, and aid projects.
body.grammar: Uses the preposition 'genom' to indicate means or method.

body.text: GGGI är en internationell organisation med huvudkontor i Seoul som startade på koreanskt initiativ år 2012.
body.en: GGGI is an international organization with headquarters in Seoul that started on Korean initiative in 2012.
body.grammar: Features a relative clause beginning with 'som' referring back to the organization.

body.text: Minister Kim Sung-hwan säger att man vill nå konkreta resultat som hjälper utvecklingsländer att nå koldioxidneutralitet.
body.en: Minister Kim Sung-hwan says that they want to reach concrete results that help developing countries achieve carbon neutrality.
body.grammar: Contains a relative clause ('som hjälper') and an embedded clause with an infinitive phrase ('att nå koldioxidneutralitet').

title.ko: 기후부와 GGGI가 녹색성장 협력을 시작했어요
title.sv: Klimatdepartementet och GGGI samarbetar om grön tillväxt
title.en: Climate ministry and GGGI cooperate on green growth

summary.ko: 기후에너지환경부와 글로벌녹색성장기구가 양해각서를 체결했어요. 두 기관은 튀르키예에서 열린 회의에서 만났어요. 이번 협력으로 에너지전환과 수소경제 분야로 일을 넓혀가요. 개발도상국의 탄소중립을 돕기로 했어요. 글로벌녹색성장기구는 서울에 본부를 둔 국제기구예요. 김성환 기후부 장관이 실질적인 성과를 만들겠다고 말했어요.
summary.sv: Klimatdepartementet och GGGI har skrivit ett avtal. De möttes på ett möte i Turkiet. Samarbetet handlar nu också om energiomställning. De ska hjälpa utvecklingsländer med klimatet. GGGI är en internationell organisation med säte i Seoul. Minister Kim Sung-hwan vill se bra resultat.
summary.en: The climate ministry and GGGI signed an agreement. They met at a meeting in Turkey. The cooperation now also covers energy transition. They will help developing countries with the climate. GGGI is an international organization based in Seoul. Minister Kim Sung-hwan wants to see good results.

title.text: 기후부와 GGGI가 녹색성장 협력을 시작했어요
title.en: The Climate Ministry and GGGI started green growth cooperation
title.grammar: Uses the subject particle 와/과 meaning 'and', and the polite past tense ending -었어요.

body.text: 기후에너지환경부와 글로벌녹색성장기구가 양해각서를 체결했어요.
body.en: The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Global Green Growth Institute signed a memorandum of understanding.
body.grammar: Uses the object particle 를/을 and the polite past tense ending -었어요.

기후에너지환경부와.en: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment (and)

body.text: 두 기관은 튀르키예에서 열린 회의에서 만났어요.
body.en: The two organizations met at a meeting held in Turkey.
body.grammar: Uses the modifier form -ㄴ/은 of verbs to modify nouns, and the location particle 에서.

body.text: 이번 협력으로 에너지전환과 수소경제 분야로 일을 넓혀가요.
body.en: Through this cooperation, we are expanding work into the fields of energy transition and the hydrogen economy.
body.grammar: Uses the instrumental particle (으)로 meaning 'through/into' and the continuous action form -아/어 가다.

body.text: 개발도상국의 탄소중립을 돕기로 했어요.
body.en: They decided to help developing countries achieve carbon neutrality.
body.grammar: Uses the nominalizing suffix -기 and the auxiliary structure -기로 하다 meaning 'to decide to do'.

body.text: 글로벌녹색성장기구는 서울에 본부를 둔 국제기구예요.
body.en: The Global Green Growth Institute is an international organization headquartered in Seoul.
body.grammar: Uses the modifying form -ㄴ of descriptive verbs and the copula 예요.

body.text: 김성환 기후부 장관이 실질적인 성과를 만들겠다고 말했어요.
body.en: Climate Minister Kim Sung-hwan said he will produce practical results.
body.grammar: Uses the indirect quotation marker -다고 and the future/volition ending -겠-.

title.text: Klimatdepartementet och GGGI samarbetar om grön tillväxt
title.en: The Climate Department and GGGI cooperate on green growth
title.grammar: Uses present tense verbs (-ar) and common compound nouns in Swedish.

body.text: De ska hjälpa utvecklingsländer med klimatet.
body.en: They will help developing countries with the climate.
body.grammar: Uses the auxiliary verb 'ska' followed by the infinitive form of the main verb ('hjälpa').

body.text: GGGI är en internationell organisation med säte i Seoul.
body.en: GGGI is an international organization based in Seoul.
body.grammar: Uses the indefinite article 'en' with a noun phrase modified by a prepositional phrase ('med säte i').

body.text: Minister Kim Sung-hwan vill se bra resultat.

body.grammar: Combines a modal-like verb 'vill' with the infinitive 'se'.

title.ko: 김포 메추리 농장 AI 항원 확인, 수도권 일시 이동 중지
title.sv: Fågelinfluensa på vaktelfarm leder till tillfälligt transportstopp
title.en: Bird flu at quail farm leads to temporary travel ban in capital region

summary.ko:
경기도 김포시에 있는 한 메추리 농장에서 조류인플루엔자 항원이 나와서 방역 당국이 조사하고 있어요. 당국은 해당 농장에 초동 대응팀을 보내서 출입을 막고 가축 처분과 조사를 진행하고 있어요. 확산을 막기 위해 수도권의 메추리 농장과 축산 시설, 차량 등에 하루 동안 일시 이동 중지 명령을 내렸어요.

이번 조치는 최근 가금 농장에서 조류인플루엔자가 계속 나오기 때문이에요. 당국은 축산 농가에서 가금의 폐사가 늘거나 알을 낳는 비율이 줄어드는 등 의심 증상이 보이면 바로 신고해 달라고 부탁했어요.
summary.sv:
Ett fågelinfluensavirus har upptäckts på en vaktelfarm i Gimpo, och myndigheterna undersöker situationen. Ett insatsteam har skickats till gården för att kontrollera inpassering och göra undersökningar. För att stoppa spridningen har ett tjugofyra timmars transportstopp införts för gårdar och fordon i regionen.

Åtgärden vidtas eftersom liknande fall har upptäckts på flera gårdar den senaste tiden. Myndigheterna uppmanar alla djurägare att omedelbart anmäla om djuren visar tecken på sjukdom eller minskad aptit.
summary.en:
A bird flu virus has been detected at a quail farm in Gimpo, and authorities are investigating the situation. A response team has been sent to the farm to control access and conduct investigations. To stop the spread, a twenty four hour movement ban has been ordered for farms and vehicles in the capital region.

This action comes after several recent cases at poultry farms. Authorities are asking farmers to immediately report any signs of illness or reduced feed intake in their animals.

title.text: 김포 메추리 농장 AI 항원 확인, 수도권 일시 이동 중지
title.en: Gimpo quail farm AI antigen confirmed, temporary travel ban in the metropolitan area
title.grammar: Headline style omits verbs and polite endings, using noun phrases linked by commas.

body.text: 경기도 김포시에 있는 한 메추리 농장에서 조류인플루엔자 항원이 나와서 방역 당국이 조사하고 있어요.
body.en: An avian influenza antigen was found at a quail farm in Gimpo-si, Gyeonggi Province, and quarantine authorities are investigating.
body.grammar: The connective '-아서' indicates cause and effect ('because... so...').

body.text: 당국은 해당 농장에 초동 대응팀을 보내서 출입을 막고 가축 처분과 조사를 진행하고 있어요.
body.en: The authorities sent an initial response team to the farm to block access and are proceeding with livestock disposal and investigation.
body.grammar: Serial verb constructions using '-고' link multiple continuous actions performed by the subject.

body.text: 확산을 막기 위해 수도권의 메추리 농장과 축산 시설, 차량 등에 하루 동안 일시 이동 중지 명령을 내렸어요.
body.en: To prevent the spread, a temporary stop-movement order has been issued for one day on quail farms, livestock facilities, and vehicles in the metropolitan area.
body.grammar: The grammar pattern '-기 위해' expresses purpose ('in order to').

body.text: 이번 조치는 최근 가금 농장에서 조류인플루엔자가 계속 나오기 때문이에요.
body.en: This measure is because avian influenza continues to emerge from poultry farms recently.
body.grammar: The ending '기 때문이에요' explains the reason ('it is because...').

body.text: 당국은 축산 농가에서 가금의 폐사가 늘거나 알을 낳는 비율이 줄어드는 등 의심 증상이 보이면 바로 신고해 달라고 부탁했어요.
body.en: The authorities requested that if suspicious symptoms are seen, such as an increase in poultry deaths or a decrease in the egg-laying rate at livestock farms, they should report it immediately.
body.grammar: Conditional clause using '-으면' ('if') combined with indirect quotation '-해 달라고 부탁했어요' ('asked to do for them').

title.text: Fågelinfluensa på vaktelfarm leder till tillfälligt transportstopp
title.en: Bird flu on a quail farm leads to temporary transport stop
title.grammar: Compound nouns ('fågelinfluensa', 'vaktelfarm', 'transportstopp') are characteristic of Swedish news headlines.

body.text: Ett fågelinfluensavirus har upptäckts på en vaktelfarm i Gimpo, och myndigheterna undersöker situationen.
body.en: An avian influenza virus has been discovered at a quail farm in Gimpo, and the authorities are investigating the situation.
body.grammar: Two main clauses are joined by the coordinating conjunction 'och'. V2 word order applies in each clause.

body.text: Ett insatsteam har skickats till gården för att kontrollera inpassering och göra undersökningar.
body.en: An intervention team has been sent to the farm to check access and make investigations.
body.grammar: The infinitive marker 'att' is used after the preposition 'för' in the purpose clause 'för att kontrollera'.

body.text: För att stoppa spridningen har ett tjugofyra timmars transportstopp införts för gårdar och fordon i regionen.
body.en: To stop the spread, a twenty-four-hour transport stop has been introduced for farms and vehicles in the region.
body.grammar: Inverted word order is used because the introductory dependent clause 'För att stoppa spridningen' occupies the first position.

body.text: Åtgärden vidtas eftersom liknande fall har upptäckts på flera gårdar den senaste tiden.
body.en: The measure is being taken because similar cases have been discovered on several farms recently.
body.grammar: The passive form 'vidtas' uses the synthetic present passive ending '-as'. The subordinating conjunction 'eftersom' introduces the reason clause.

body.text: Myndigheterna uppmanar alla djurägare att omedelbart anmäla om djuren visar tecken på sjukdom eller minskad aptit.
body.en: The authorities urge all animal owners to immediately report if the animals show signs of illness or decreased appetite.
body.grammar: The verb 'uppmanar' takes an object ('alla djurägare') and an infinitive clause with 'att'.

title.ko: 경기도 김포 메추리 농장에서 조류인플루엔자 항원이 나왔어요
title.sv: Fågelinfluensa har hittats på en vaktel farm i Gimpo
title.en: Bird flu virus found at a quail farm in Gimpo

summary.ko: 경기도 김포의 한 메추리 농장에서 조류인플루엔자 항원이 발견됐어요. 정부는 농장 문을 닫고 조사하고 있어요. 수도권 농장과 차량은 하루 동안 이동을 멈춰야 해요. 정부는 농장에서 작은 증상만 있어도 바로 알려달라고 했어요.
summary.sv: Fågelinfluensa har upptäckts på en vaktelfarm i Gimpo. Myndigheterna har stängt av gården och undersöker saken. Transporter och gårdar i regionen måste stanna i tjugofyra timmar. Myndigheterna ber alla bönder att anmäla små symtom genast.
summary.en: Bird flu virus has been found at a quail farm in Gimpo. The government has blocked access to the farm and is investigating. Farms and vehicles in the capital region must stop moving for twenty four hours. The government asks farmers to report even small symptoms immediately.

title.text: 경기도 김포 메추리 농장에서 조류인플루엔자 항원이 나왔어요
title.en: Avian influenza antigens were found at a quail farm in Gimpo, Gyeonggi Province
title.grammar: The sentence follows the standard Subject-Location-Verb pattern. The ending '-었어요' is a polite past tense marker.

body.text: 경기도 김포의 한 메추리 농장에서 조류인플루엔자 항원이 발견됐어요.
body.en: Avian influenza antigens were discovered at a quail farm in Gimpo, Gyeonggi Province.
body.grammar: The passive form '-되다' is used in '발견됐어요', changing the verb 'to discover' into 'to be discovered'.

body.text: 정부는 농장 문을 닫고 조사하고 있어요.
body.en: The government has closed the farm and is investigating.
body.grammar: The connective '-고' links two verbs together, meaning 'and' in sequential actions.

body.text: 수도권 농장과 차량은 하루 동안 이동을 멈춰야 해요.
body.en: Farms and vehicles in the metropolitan area must stop moving for a day.
body.grammar: The auxiliary ending '-어야 해요' expresses necessity or obligation ('must').

body.text: 정부는 농장에서 작은 증상만 있어도 바로 알려달라고 했어요.
body.en: The government said that even if there are small symptoms on the farm, they should report them immediately.
body.grammar: Indirect quotation is used with '-다고 했어요' ('said that'). The conditional form '-만 있어도' means 'even if there is only'.

title.text: Fågelinfluensa har hittats på en vaktel farm i Gimpo
title.en: Bird flu has been found at a quail farm in Gimpo
title.grammar: The passive form 'har hittats' (has been found) is used with the auxiliary verb 'har' and the supine form.

body.text: Fågelinfluensa har upptäckts på en vaktelfarm i Gimpo.
body.en: Bird flu has been discovered at a quail farm in Gimpo.
body.grammar: Compound nouns in Swedish are written as one word, such as 'vaktelfarm'.

title.ko: 최교진 교육부 장관의 수능 인공지능 부정행위 관련 발언이 논란을 빚고 있어요
title.sv: Uttalanden om AI-fusk på prov skapar förvirring i regeringen
title.en: Education minister faces criticism over remarks on AI cheating during exams

summary.ko:
대학수학능력시험을 사흘 앞둔 16일, 국회 교육위원회 전체회의에서 인공지능을 활용한 부정행위 방지 대책이 다뤄졌어요. 이날 박정훈 국민의힘 의원은 최교진 교육부 장관에게 인공지능을 활용한 부정행위를 장관이 100% 잡아낼 자신이 있느냐고 물었어요. 이에 최 장관은 제 나이가 있어서 개인은 그것을 하기가 어렵겠다고 답해 눈길을 끌었어요.

의원이 교육부 수장이 그런 식이면 어쩌냐고 따져 묻자 최 장관은 현장에 나가 있는 사람들이 적발할 자신이 있느냐는 뜻이었다고 해명했어요. 회의장에서는 탄식이 터져 나왔고 의원은 답답함을 토로했어요. 최 장관은 스마트 안경 같은 변종 수법을 다 막기에는 완벽하지 못할 것 같다고 덧붙였어요.

부정행위 방지책과 관련해 수험 시간 전파 차단을 검토하겠다고 한 최 장관의 답변도 혼란을 불렀어요. 교육부는 이후 공지를 내어 법적 기술적 한계로 전파 차단은 검토하지 않고 있다고 바로잡았어요. 또한 장관의 나이 관련 발언도 현장 감독관들의 어려움에 공감한 것이라고 해명하며 진화에 나섰어요.
summary.sv:
Bara tre dagar före de stora proven diskuterade parlamentet hur man ska stoppa fusk med artificifikell intelligens. En politiker frågade utbildningsministern om han kunde lova att stoppa all typ av AI-fusk. Ministern svarade att han på grund av sin ålder inte skulle klara av en sådan uppgift. Detta väckte starka reaktioner och folk i lokalen suckade högt över svaret.

När politikern frågade vidare svarade ministern att relaterade frågor borde besvaras av en annan tjänsteman. Ministern sa också att det är svårt att vara helt perfekt när folk ständigt hittar nya metoder för att fuska. Vidare skapade ministern förvirring när han först sa att man skulle undersöka om det gick att blockera signaler i lokalen.

Efter mötet skickade utbildningsdepartementet ut ett meddelande för att förklara situationen. De sa att signalblockering inte är aktuellt på grund av tekniska och lagliga gränser. Departementet förklarade också att ministerns ord om sin ålder bara handlade om att visa förståelse för hur svårt det är för provvakterna på plats.
summary.en:
Just three days before the college entrance exams, the parliamentary education committee discussed measures to prevent cheating using artificial intelligence. During the session, a lawmaker asked the education minister if he was confident that he could catch one hundred percent of AI-related cheating. The minister replied that due to his age, he did not think he could do it personally.

When the lawmaker pressed further, asking if the head of the education ministry should be saying such things, the minister clarified that he meant it is hard for an individual to handle. Sighs broke out in the meeting room, and the lawmaker expressed frustration. The minister also admitted that the ministry's response might not be completely perfect in stopping endless new cheating methods like smart glasses.

The minister also caused confusion by initially stating he would look into blocking wireless signals during exam hours. The education ministry later issued a notice explaining that signal blocking was not being considered due to legal and technical limitations. The ministry also tried to calm the situation by stating that the minister's age remark was an expression of empathy for exam supervisors facing difficulties rather than an admission of incompetence.

title.text: 최교진 교육부 장관의 수능 인공지능 부정행위 관련 발언이 논란을 빚고 있어요
title.en: Remarks by Minister of Education Choi Kyo-jin regarding AI cheating on the CSAT are causing controversy.
title.grammar: The modifier ending '-ㄴ' turns the verb '빚다' into a continuous state with '고 있어요'. Complex noun compounding is heavily used in news titles.

body.text: 대학수학능력시험을 사흘 앞둔 16일, 국회 교육위원회 전체회의에서 인공지능을 활용한 부정행위 방지 대책이 다뤄졌어요.
body.en: On the 16th, three days ahead of the College Scholastic Ability Test, preventive measures against AI-utilized cheating were discussed at the National Assembly Education Committee plenary session.
body.grammar: Apposition and time expressions are placed before the main clause. The passive suffix '-어지-' is attached to '다루다' to form '다뤄졌어요'.

body.text: 이날 박정훈 국민의힘 의원은 최교진 교육부 장관에게 인공지능을 활용한 부정행위를 장관이 100% 잡아낼 자신이 있느냐고 물었어요.
body.en: On this day, People Power Party lawmaker Park Jung-hoon asked Minister of Education Choi Kyo-jin whether he was confident that the minister could catch 100% of AI-utilized cheating.
body.grammar: The indirect quotation ending '-느냐고' embeds a direct question into reported speech. The bound noun phrase '자신이 있느냐고' inquires about confidence.

body.text: 이에 최 장관은 제 나이가 있어서 개인은 그것을 하기가 어렵겠다고 답해 눈길을 끌었어요.
body.en: In response, Minister Choi drew attention by answering that because of his age, it would be difficult for an individual to do so.
body.grammar: The idiomatic expression '눈길을 끌었어요' means 'drew attention'. The connective '-아/어 답해' links sequential actions.

body.text: 의원이 교육부 수장이 그런 식이면 어쩌냐고 따져 묻자 최 장관은 현장에 나가 있는 사람들이 적발할 자신이 있느냐는 뜻이었다고 해명했어요.
body.en: When a lawmaker pressed him asking how things could be like that if he is the head of the Ministry of Education, Minister Choi clarified that it meant whether the people out in the field had the confidence to detect them.
body.grammar: The quoting pattern '-는 뜻이었다고' explains the underlying intention of a previous statement. The construction '-는 식이면 어쩌냐고' questions an inappropriate attitude.

body.text: 회의장에서는 탄식이 터져 나왔고 의원은 답답함을 토로했어요.
body.en: A sigh burst out in the meeting room, and the lawmaker expressed frustration.
body.grammar: The compound verb '터져 나왔고' combines '터지다' (burst) and '나오다' (come out). The phrase '토로했어요' expresses deep emotional disclosure.

body.text: 최 장관은 스마트 안경 같은 변종 수법을 다 막기에는 완벽하지 못할 것 같다고 덧붙였어요.
body.en: Minister Choi added that it likely would not be perfect to block all variant methods like smart glasses.
body.grammar: The explanatory ending '-기에는' limits the scope of difficulty. The verb '덧붙였어요' means 'added/appended' in speech.

body.text: 부정행위 방지책과 관련해 수험 시간 전파 차단을 검토하겠다고 한 최 장관의 답변도 혼란을 불렀어요.
body.en: Minister Choi's answer stating that he would review blocking signal transmission before exam hours regarding preventive measures against cheating also caused confusion.
body.grammar: The noun modifier '-다고 한' embeds a quotation inside a descriptive noun phrase. The future intention is expressed with '-겠다고'.

body.text: 교육부는 이후 공지를 내어 법적 기술적 한계로 전파 차단은 검토하지 않고 있다고 바로잡았어요.
body.en: The Ministry of Education subsequently issued a notice to correct that signal blocking is not being reviewed due to legal and technical limitations.
body.grammar: The connective phrase '-는 덕분에/로' or '로 인해' is implied by '한계로' (due to limitations). The verb '바로잡다' means 'to correct/rectify'.

body.text: 또한 장관의 나이 관련 발언도 현장 감독관들의 어려움에 공감한 것이라고 해명하며 진화에 나섰어요.
body.en: In addition, it explained that the minister's remarks regarding age were intended to express empathy for the difficulties faced by on-site supervisors, thereby moving to defuse the controversy.
body.grammar: The connective ending '-며' links concurrent actions ('해명하며 진화에 나섰어요'). The fixed phrase '진화에 나섰어요' metaphorically means 'stepped in to put out the fire/controversy'.

title.text: Uttalanden om AI-fusk på prov skapar förvirring i regeringen
title.en: Statements about AI cheating on exams create confusion in the government
title.grammar: Compound nouns like 'AI-fusk' combine abbreviations with nouns using a hyphen. The verb 'skapar' is in the present tense.

body.text: Bara tre dagar före de stora proven diskuterade parlamentet hur man ska stoppa fusk med artificifikell intelligens.
body.en: Just three days before the big exams, parliament discussed how to stop cheating with artificial intelligence.
body.grammar: Inverted word order is used because the adverbial phrase 'Bara tre dagar före...' starts the sentence, placing the finite verb 'diskuterade' in second position (V2 rule).

body.text: En politiker frågade utbildningsministern om han kunde lova att stoppa all typ av AI-fusk.
body.en: A politician asked the Minister of Education if he could promise to stop all types of AI cheating.
body.grammar: The indirect question uses 'om' and maintains standard subordinate clause structure. The verb phrase 'kunde lova' combines past modal with infinitive.

body.text: Ministern svarade att han på grund av sin ålder inte skulle klara av en sådan uppgift.
body.en: The minister answered that due to his age he would not manage such a task.
body.grammar: The prepositional phrase 'på grund av' means 'due to'. The conditional auxiliary 'skulle' combined with 'klara av' expresses hypothetical inability.

body.text: Detta väckte starka reaktioner och folk i lokalen suckade högt över svaret.
body.en: This aroused strong reactions, and people in the room sighed loudly over the answer.
body.grammar: The neuter pronoun 'Det' acts as the grammatical subject. The adverb 'högt' modifies the verb 'suckade'.

body.text: När politikern frågade vidare svarade ministern att relaterade frågor borde besvaras av en annan tjänsteman.
body.en: When the politician asked further, the minister replied that related questions should be answered by another official.
body.grammar: The passive form 'borde besvaras' uses the modal 'borde' (ought to) with a passive infinitive ending in '-as'.

body.text: Ministern sa också att det är svårt att vara helt perfekt när folk ständigt hittar nya metoder för att fuska.
body.en: The minister also said that it is difficult to be completely perfect when people constantly find new methods to cheat.
body.grammar: The subordinate clause 'när folk ständigt hittar...' uses the conjunction 'när'. The word 'ständigt' is an adverb meaning 'constantly'.

body.text: Vidare skapade ministern förvirring när han först sa att man skulle undersöka om det gick att blockera signaler i lokalen.
body.en: Furthermore, the minister created confusion when he first said that they would investigate whether it was possible to block signals in the room.
body.grammar: Inverted word order follows the initial adverb 'Vidare'. The phrase 'om det gick att' uses the past tense 'gick' to mean 'whether it was possible'.

body.text: Efter mötet skickade utbildningsdepartementet ut ett meddelande för att förklara situationen.
body.en: After the meeting, the Ministry of Education sent out a message to explain the situation.
body.grammar: The particle verb 'skickade ut' separates the verb 'skickade' from the particle 'ut'. The infinitive marker 'att' precedes 'förklara'.

body.text: De sa att signalblockering inte är aktuellt på grund av tekniska och lagliga gränser.
body.en: They said that signal blocking is not relevant due to technical and legal limits.
body.grammar: The phrase 'är inte aktuellt' uses the predicate adjective 'aktuell' meaning 'relevant' or 'currently under consideration'.

body.text: Departementet förklarade också att ministerns ord om sin ålder bara handlade om att visa förståelse för hur svårt det är för provvakterna på plats.
body.en: The department also explained that the minister's words about his age were only about showing understanding of how difficult it is for the proctors on site.
body.grammar: The reflexive particle verb 'handlade om' means 'was about'. The phrase 'på plats' translates to 'on site'.

title.ko: 교육부 장관의 수능 인공지능 부정행위 답변이 논란이에요
title.sv: Utbildningsministern skapar debatt om fusk med AI i skolan
title.en: Education minister sparks debate over AI cheating in exams

summary.ko: 수능을 사흘 앞두고 국회 교육위원회 회의가 열렸어요. 최교진 교육부 장관이 인공지능 부정행위를 100퍼센트 잡을 수 있냐는 질문을 받았어요. 최 장관은 제 나이가 있어서 못 할 것 같다고 답했어요. 의원이 교육부 수장이 그럴 수 있냐고 다시 물었어요. 최 장관은 개인은 하기 어렵다는 뜻이라고 해명했어요. 최 장관은 새로운 부정행위를 다 막기는 완벽하지 못할 것이라고 했어요. 회의장에서는 탄식이 나왔고 의원은 답답해했어요. 교육부는 장관의 말이 현장 감독관의 어려움에 공감한 것이라고 설명했어요.
summary.sv: Sveriges och Koreas utbildningsminister talade om fusk i skolan med AI. Universitetsproven är snart här och regeringen funderar på regler. summary.en: The education minister spoke in parliament three days before important exams. A politician asked if the minister can stop all AI cheating completely. The minister answered that he cannot do it because of his age. People in the room sighed and thought the answer was bad. The minister later said it is hard for one person to do. The ministry explained that he only meant it is hard for supervisors at exam sites.

title.text: 교육부 장관의 수능 인공지능 부정행위 답변이 논란이에요
title.en: The Minister of Education's answer regarding AI cheating on the CSAT is controversial.
title.grammar: The topic marker '의' indicates possession. The noun '논란이에요' is formed with the polite copula ending '이에요'.

body.text: 수능을 사흘 앞두고 국회 교육위원회 회의가 열렸어요.
body.en: Three days before the CSAT, a meeting of the National Assembly Education Committee was held.
body.grammar: The noun modifier ending '-고' connects clauses sequentially meaning 'after doing'. The passive verb '열렸어요' is used for events being held.

body.text: 최교진 교육부 장관이 인공지능 부정행위를 100퍼센트 잡을 수 있냐는 질문을 받았어요.
body.en: Minister of Education Choi Kyo-jin received a question asking if he could catch 100 percent of AI cheating.
body.grammar: Reported speech structure is used with '-냐는', asking whether. The suffix '-을 수 있냐는' combines ability with indirect question quoting.

body.text: 최 장관은 제 나이가 있어서 못 할 것 같다고 답했어요.
body.en: Minister Choi answered that because of his age, he doesn't think he can do it.
body.grammar: The cause-and-effect construction '-아서/어서' connects the reason. The quotation ending '-다고 답했어요' reports a direct statement.

body.text: 의원이 교육부 수장이 그럴 수 있냐고 다시 물었어요.
body.en: A lawmaker asked again if the head of the Ministry of Education could be like that.
body.grammar: The indirect quotation uses '-냐고' to report a question. The modifier '그럴 수 있냐고' questions someone's behavior.

body.text: 최 장관은 개인은 하기 어렵다는 뜻이라고 해명했어요.
body.en: Minister Choi clarified that it meant individuals would find it difficult to do.
body.grammar: Nominalization with '-는 뜻이다' expresses what a previous statement meant. The adjective '어렵다' governs the subject '개인은'.

body.text: 최 장관은 새로운 부정행위를 다 막기는 완벽하지 못할 것이라고 했어요.
body.en: Minister Choi said that it would not be perfect to block all new forms of cheating.
body.grammar: The future presumptive ending '-ㄹ 것' combined with '것이다' expresses prediction. The adverb '다' means 'all' or 'completely'.

body.text: 회의장에서는 탄식이 나왔고 의원은 답답해했어요.
body.en: A sigh came out in the meeting room, and the lawmaker felt frustrated.
body.grammar: The conjunctive suffix '-고' links two independent clauses. The verb '답답해했어요' describes someone's emotional state in the third person.

body.text: 교육부는 장관의 말이 현장 감독관의 어려움에 공감한 것이라고 설명했어요.
body.en: The Ministry of Education explained that the minister's words sympathized with the difficulties of on-site supervisors.
body.grammar: The nominalized clause ending in '-것이다' forms an explanatory predicate. The past modifier '-ㄴ' turns the verb '공감한' into an adjective modifying the noun.

title.text: Utbildningsministern skapar debatt om fusk med AI i skolan
title.en: The Minister of Education creates debate about cheating with AI in school
title.grammar: The present tense is formed with the ending '-r' on the verb 'skapar'. Compound nouns like 'Utbildningsministern' and 'skol-AI' are written as single words in Swedish.

body.text: Sveriges och Koreas utbildningsminister talade om fusk i skolan med AI.
body.en: Sweden's and Korea's Minister of Education spoke about cheating in school with AI.
body.grammar: The genitive marker '-s' shows possession on 'Sveriges' and 'Koreas'. The past tense of the irregular verb 'tala' is 'talade'.

body.text: Universitetsproven är snart här och regeringen funderar på regler.
body.en: The university exams are soon here and the government is thinking about rules.
body.grammar: The phrasal verb 'funderar på' combines the verb 'fundera' with the preposition 'på'. Definite plural forms are used for 'prov' -> 'proven'.

body.text: En politiker frågade om ministern kan stoppa all AI-fusk.
body.en: A politician asked if the minister can stop all AI cheating.
body.grammar: Indirect questions in Swedish do not invert subject and verb, keeping normal word order after 'om'. The modal verb 'kan' expresses ability.

body.text: Ministern svarade att han är för gammal för det.
body.en: The minister answered that he is too old for that.
body.grammar: The subordinate clause introduced by 'att' follows standard V-final word order in the subordinate clause. The predicate adjective 'för gammal' means 'too old'.

body.text: Det väckte ilska och folk suckade i mötet.

body.grammar: The past tense of strong verbs is used ('väckte'). Definite singular form 'mötet' attaches the suffix '-et' to the neuter noun 'möte'.

body.text: Ministern förklarade att det är svårt för en enda person.

body.text: Departementet sa senare att ministern bara förstår lärarnas problem.
