title.ko: 이재명 대통령 부부, 필리핀 갈라 만찬에서 전통의상 입어
title.sv: Presidentparet bar filippinska kläder på galamiddag
title.en: Presidential couple wears traditional clothes at Philippine gala dinner

summary.ko:
아세안 정상회의 참석차 필리핀을 방문한 이재명 대통령 부부가 현지 갈라 만찬에 참석했어요. 이번 만찬은 페르디난드 마르코스 주니어 필리핀 대통령 내외가 주최한 자리였어요.

이 대통령 부부는 필리핀 측에서 특별히 제작한 현지 전통의상을 입고 행사장에 나타났어요. 이들의 특별한 의상은 현지 사람들의 눈길을 끌었어요.

대통령 부부는 전통의상을 입은 채로 영접을 나온 필리핀 대통령 내외를 만났어요. 두 부부는 밝게 웃으며 악수를 나눈 뒤 함께 만찬장으로 이동했어요.
summary.sv:
Sveriges president och hans fru besöker Filippinerna för ett toppmöte med ASEAN. Den 16 november deltog de i en galamiddag i Manila. Middagen arrangerades av Filippinernas president Ferdinand Marcos Jr. och hans fru.

På middagen bar presidentparet traditionella kläder som hade tillverkats särskilt för dem av den filippinska sidan. Kläderna var ett uppmärksammat inslag under kvällen.

När paret anlände till festlokalen möttes de av det filippinska presidentparet. De log och skakade hand med varandra innan de gick vidare in i matsalen.
summary.en:
President Lee Jae-myung and his wife, who are visiting the Philippines to attend the ASEAN summit, attended a local gala dinner on November 16. The dinner was hosted by Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his wife.

The presidential couple arrived at the venue wearing traditional Philippine clothing specially prepared by the host country. Their special outfits drew attention at the event.

The president and his wife met the Philippine presidential couple who came out to greet them while wearing the traditional clothes. The two couples exchanged bright smiles and handshakes before moving into the dining hall together.

title.text: 이재명 대통령 부부, 필리핀 갈라 만찬에서 전통의상 입어
title.en: President Lee Jae-myung and his wife wear traditional clothes at the Philippine gala dinner
title.grammar: News headline style ending in a noun form or plain verb stem (입어) without polite honorific endings. The subject is a compound noun phrase joined by a comma.

body.text: 아세안 정상회의 참석차 필리핀을 방문한 이재명 대통령 부부가 현지 갈라 만찬에 참석했어요.
body.en: President Lee Jae-myung and his wife, who visited the Philippines to attend the ASEAN summit, attended the local gala dinner.
body.grammar: The modifier clause 방문한 modifies the subject noun phrase. 참석차 expresses purpose ('for the purpose of attending').

body.text: 이번 만찬은 페르디난드 마르코스 주니어 필리핀 대통령 내외가 주최한 자리였어요.
body.en: This dinner was hosted by Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his wife.
body.grammar: The sentence ends with the nominal ending -자리였어요 ('was a gathering/occasion'). 내외 refers to a married couple formally.

body.text: 이 대통령 부부는 필리핀 측에서 특별히 제작한 현지 전통의상을 입고 행사장에 나타났어요.
body.en: President Lee and his wife appeared at the venue wearing local traditional clothes specially produced by the Philippine side.
body.grammar: The adverbial form -고 나타났어요 combines two actions ('appeared while wearing'). 측에서 indicates 'from the side/party of'.

body.text: 이들의 특별한 의상은 현지 사람들의 눈길을 끌었어요.
body.en: Their special outfits drew the attention of the local people.
body.grammar: The fixed expression 눈길을 끌다 means 'to draw attention'. 이들의 is the possessive form of 이들 ('these people / they').

body.text: 대통령 부부는 전통의상을 입은 채로 영접을 나온 필리핀 대통령 내외를 만났어요.
body.en: The president and his wife met the Philippine president and his wife who came out to greet them, while wearing the traditional clothes.
body.grammar: The grammatical pattern -(으)ㄴ 채로 means 'while leaving a state as it is ('while wearing'). 영접을 나온 modifies the greeting couple.

body.text: 두 부부는 밝게 웃으며 악수를 나눈 뒤 함께 만찬장으로 이동했어요.
body.en: The two couples smiled brightly, exchanged handshakes, and then moved together to the dinner hall.
body.grammar: Sequential actions are linked with -ㄴ 뒤 ('after doing'). 밝게 is the adverbial form of 밝다 ('brightly').

만찬장으로.en: to the dinner hall (+ direction particle)

title.text: Presidentparet bar filippinska kläder på galamiddag
title.en: Presidential couple wore Filipino clothes at gala dinner
title.grammar: Newspaper headline style omitting articles (en/ett). Bar is the past tense of bära.

body.text: Sveriges president och hans fru besöker Filippinerna för ett toppmöte med ASEAN.
body.en: Sweden's president and his wife are visiting the Philippines for a summit with ASEAN.
body.grammar: Present continuous sense expressed with present tense besöker. Compound subject connected by och.

body.text: Den 16 november deltog de i en galamiddag i Manila.
body.en: On November 16 they participated in a gala dinner in Manila.
body.grammar: Inverted word order: prepositional phrase Den 16 november starts the sentence, so the verb deltog immediately follows.

body.text: Middagen arrangerades av Filippinernas president Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
body.en: The dinner was hosted by the Philippines' president Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
body.grammar: Passive voice formed with the auxiliary -s (arrangerades).

body.text: och hans fru.
body.en: and his wife.
body.grammar: Fragment sentence continuing the previous thought, introduced by conjunction och.

body.text: På middagen bar presidentparet traditionella kläder som hade tillverkats särskilt för dem av den filippinska sidan.
body.en: At the dinner, the presidential couple wore traditional clothes that had been manufactured especially for them by the Philippine side.
body.grammar: Relative clause introduced by som ('that'). Passive pluperfect (hade tillverkats).

body.text: Kläderna var ett uppmärksammat inslag under kvällen.
body.en: The clothes were a notable feature during the evening.
body.grammar: Definite noun form (kläderna). Uppmärksammat is a participle acting as an adjective ('noted / remarkable').

body.text: När paret anlände till festlokalen möttes de av det filippinska presidentparet.
body.en: When the couple arrived at the party venue, they were met by the Philippine presidential couple.
body.grammar: Subordinate clause starting with När ('when') triggers V2 word order in the main clause (möttes de...). Passive verb möttes.

body.text: De log och skakade hand med varandra innan de gick vidare in i matsalen.
body.en: They smiled and shook hands with each other before they went further into the dining room.
body.grammar: Innan introduces a subordinate clause ('before they went'). Reflexive/reciprocal expression med varandra means 'with each other'.

title.ko: 이재명 대통령 부부가 필리핀 전통의상을 입었어요
title.sv: Sveriges president bar traditionella kläder i Filippinerna
title.en: President Lee Jae-myung and his wife wore traditional clothes in the Philippines

summary.ko:
이재명 대통령 부부가 필리핀에 갔어요. 아세안 정상회의에 참석하기 위해서예요. 마닐라에서 열린 갈라 만찬에 갔어요.

필리핀 대통령 부부가 만찬을 주최했어요. 필리핀은 대통령 부부를 위해 옷을 만들었어요. 대통령 부부는 그 전통의상을 입고 갔어요.

대통령 부부는 전통의상을 입고 만났어요. 필리핀 대통령 부부와 웃으며 악수를 했어요. 그리고 함께 만찬장으로 들어갔어요.
summary.sv:
Sveriges president och hans fru reste till Filippinerna. De besökte ett toppmöte. De gick på en middag i Manila.

Filippinernas president var värd för middagen. Filippinerna hade gjort speciella kläder till dem. Presidentparet bar dessa traditionella kläder.

Presidentparet kom till festen i kläderna. De skakade hand med det filippinska presidentparet och log. Sedan gick de in i matsalen.
summary.en:
The South Korean president and his wife traveled to the Philippines. They went to attend a summit. They attended a gala dinner in Manila.

The president of the Philippines hosted the dinner. The Philippines specially made traditional clothes for them. The president and his wife wore these traditional clothes.

The presidential couple wore the traditional outfits to the venue. They smiled and shook hands with the Philippine president and his wife. Then they walked into the dining hall.

title.text: 이재명 대통령 부부가 필리핀 전통의상을 입었어요
title.en: President Lee Jae-myung and his wife wore traditional Philippine clothes
title.grammar: The sentence ends with the polite past tense declarative ending -었어요 attached to the verb stem 입-. The subject is marked with the subject particle 가 after 부부가.

body.text: 이재명 대통령 부부가 필리핀에 갔어요.
body.en: President Lee Jae-myung and his wife went to the Philippines.
body.grammar: The destination is marked with the particle 에 (필리핀에). The verb 가다 conjugates to the past polite form 갔어요.

body.text: 아세안 정상회의에 참석하기 위해서예요.
body.en: It is in order to attend the ASEAN summit.
body.grammar: The grammar pattern -기 위해서예요 expresses purpose ('in order to'). The noun phrase 아세안 정상회의에 marks the event and target with 에.

위해서예요.en: it is for the purpose of (polite ending)

body.text: 마닐라에서 열린 갈라 만찬에 갔어요.
body.en: They went to the gala dinner held in Manila.
body.grammar: The modifier form 열린 modifies 갈라 만찬 ('the gala dinner that was held'). The location is marked by 에서.

body.text: 필리핀 대통령 부부가 만찬을 주최했어요.
body.en: The Philippine president and his wife hosted the dinner.
body.grammar: The subject particle 가 marks the host (부부가). 주최했어요 uses the past polite form of 주최하다.

body.text: 필리핀은 대통령 부부를 위해 옷을 만들었어요.
body.en: The Philippines made clothes for the president and his wife.
body.grammar: The benefactive particle -을/를 위해(서) means 'for' someone. 만들었어요 is the past polite form of 만들다.

body.text: 대통령 부부는 그 전통의상을 입고 갔어요.
body.en: The president and his wife wore those traditional clothes and went.
body.grammar: The connective ending -고 means 'and' or 'while doing'. The demonstrative pronoun 그 means 'that'.

body.text: 대통령 부부는 전통의상을 입고 만났어요.
body.en: The president and his wife wore traditional clothes and met.
body.grammar: Sequential actions are connected using the verb suffix -고 ('do and then / while doing').

body.text: 필리핀 대통령 부부와 웃으며 악수를 했어요.
body.en: They smiled and shook hands with the Philippine presidential couple.
body.grammar: The adverbial form 웃으며 connects two simultaneous actions ('smiling while shaking hands'). The object is marked with 을/를.

body.text: 그리고 함께 만찬장으로 들어갔어요.
body.en: And together they went into the dinner venue.
body.grammar: 그리고 is a conjunction meaning 'and'. 만찬장으로 uses -으로 to indicate direction ('toward/into the dinner hall').

만찬장으로.en: to the dinner hall (+ direction particle)

title.text: Sveriges president bar traditionella kläder i Filippinerna
title.en: Sweden's president wore traditional clothes in the Philippines
title.grammar: The sentence is in the simple past tense (bar). Swedish word order is subject-verb-object.

body.text: Sveriges president och hans fru reste till Filippinerna.
body.en: Sweden's president and his wife traveled to the Philippines.
body.grammar: Conjunction och connects two nouns to form a compound subject. Reste is the past tense of resa.

body.text: De besökte ett toppmöte.
body.en: They visited a summit.
body.grammar: Definite vs indefinite: ett toppmöte uses the neuter indefinite article ett.

body.text: De gick på en middag i Manila.
body.en: They went to a dinner in Manila.
body.grammar: The past tense of gå is gick. Prepositional phrase uses på en middag.

body.text: Filippinernas president var värd för middagen.
body.en: The president of the Philippines was the host of the dinner.
body.grammar: Genitive case is formed by adding -s to Filippinerna. 'Var värd för' is a fixed expression meaning 'was host for'.

body.text: Filippinerna hade gjort speciella kläder till dem.
body.en: The Philippines had made special clothes for them.
body.grammar: The pluperfect tense (hade gjort) indicates an action completed before another past event.

body.text: Presidentparet bar dessa traditionella kläder.
body.en: The presidential couple wore these traditional clothes.
body.grammar: The demonstrative pronoun dessa ('these') modifies the plural noun kläder.

body.text: Presidentparet kom till festen i kläderna.
body.en: The presidential couple came to the party in the clothes.
body.grammar: Prepositional phrase i kläderna uses the definite plural form kläderna.

body.text: De skakade hand med det filippinska presidentparet och log.
body.en: They shook hands with the Philippine presidential couple and smiled.
body.grammar: Skakade hand is a fixed verb phrase meaning 'shook hands'. Och connects the two past tense verbs skakade and log.

body.text: Sedan gick de in i matsalen.
body.en: Then they went into the dining room.
body.grammar: Inverted word order: sedan is followed by the verb gick directly (Sedan gick de...).

title.ko: 고려아연, 미국의 태양광 재활용 기업과 합작법인 설립
title.sv: Korea Zinc bildar ett samriskföretag med ett amerikanskt solcellsåtervinningsföretag
title.en: Korea Zinc forms a joint venture with a US solar recycling company

summary.ko:
고려아연이 미국의 태양광 폐패널 재활용 기업인 솔라사이클과 손을 잡았어요. 두 회사는 16일에 합작법인인 주피터 설립 계약을 맺었어요. 솔라사이클은 미국에서 태양광 패널을 수거하고 재활용하는 분야에서 경쟁력이 있는 기업이에요. 지난 2024년에는 마이크로소프트가 이 회사에 전략적 투자를 하기도 했어요. 새로운 합작법인은 고려아연의 자회사와 솔라사이클의 사업 부문 지분을 서로 출자하는 방식으로 만들어져요.

고려아연은 이번 합작을 통해 태양광 폐패널을 모으는 것부터 금속을 회수하는 것까지 이어지는 자원순환 사업을 강화할 계획이에요. 태양광 패널 안에는 유리와 알루미늄뿐만 아니라 은과 구리 같은 귀한 금속도 들어 있어요. 고려아연은 솔라사이클의 수거망을 이용해 폐패널을 안정적으로 확보하고 유가금속을 더 많이 회수하려고 해요.

특히 돈이 많이 드는 유리 분리 과정에 고려아연의 제련 기술을 도입해서 비용을 줄이고 수익을 높인다는 전략이에요. 전 세계적으로 태양광 발전이 늘어나면서 앞으로 버려지는 패널도 많아질 것으로 보여요. 고려아연은 이 시장을 먼저 잡아서 성장할 수 있는 기반을 다지겠다는 입장을 밝혔어요.
summary.sv:
Korea Zinc har börjat samarbeta med det amerikanska solcellsåtervinningsföretaget Solarcycle. Den 16 november skrev de avtal om att bilda samriskföretaget Jupiter. Solarcycle är känt för att samla in och återvinna gamla solpaneler i USA. År 2024 gjorde Microsoft en investering i företaget. Det nya bolaget skapas genom att företagen lägger in aktier från sina respektive verksamheter.

Genom det här samarbetet vill Korea Zinc bygga en hel kedja för återvinning. Kedjan börjar med insamling av gamla solpaneler och slutar med att man tar tillvara värdefulla metaller som silver och koppar. Solarcycle har ett bra nätverk för att samla in paneler. På så sätt kan företagen få en stabil tillgång på material.

Korea Zinc planerar att använda sin egen teknik för att skilja glas från andra material. Det gör processen billigare och ökar vinsterna. Eftersom solenergi blir vanligare i hela världen förväntas också mängden gamla paneler öka. Målet är att ta en stark position på marknaden tidigt för att säkra framtida tillväxt.
summary.en:
Korea Zinc has partnered with American solar panel recycling company Solarcycle. On November 16, they signed an agreement to establish a joint venture named Jupiter. Solarcycle is known for collecting and recycling waste solar panels in the US. In 2024, Microsoft made a strategic investment in the company. The new entity is formed by exchanging shares from each company's respective business sectors.

Through this partnership, Korea Zinc plans to build a complete recycling chain. This chain goes from collecting waste panels to recovering valuable metals like silver and copper. Solarcycle has a strong network for collecting panels, which helps secure a steady supply of materials. Korea Zinc plans to use its own smelting technology to reduce the high costs of the glass-separation process, thereby increasing profitability.

As global solar power generation expands, the amount of waste panels is expected to increase in the future. Korea Zinc stated that its goal is to secure a foothold in this market early to build a strong foundation for growth.

title.text: 고려아연, 미국의 태양광 재활용 기업과 합작법인 설립
title.en: Korea Zinc establishes a joint venture with an American solar recycling company
title.grammar: Headline style sentence ending with noun forms (설립) rather than a polite verb ending, typical for news titles.

body.text: 고려아연이 미국의 태양광 폐패널 재활용 기업인 솔라사이클과 손을 잡았어요.
body.en: Korea Zinc joined hands with Solarcycle, an American solar waste panel recycling company.
body.grammar: The idiom 손을 잡았어요 literally means 'held hands', used here to mean 'formed a partnership'. The modifier ending 인 links the appositive description.

body.text: 두 회사는 16일에 합작법인인 주피터 설립 계약을 맺었어요.
body.en: The two companies signed a contract on the 16th to establish the joint venture Jupiter.
body.grammar: The time particle -에 indicates the specific date (16일에). The noun modifier contract phrase 설립 계약 specifies the purpose.

body.text: 솔라사이클은 미국에서 태양광 패널을 수거하고 재활용하는 분야에서 경쟁력이 있는 기업이에요.
body.en: Solarcycle is a company that has competitiveness in the field of collecting and recycling solar panels in the US.
body.grammar: The nominalizing ending -는 분야에서 specifies the domain. Competitiveness is expressed through the noun expression 경쟁력이 있는.

body.text: 지난 2024년에는 마이크로소프트가 이 회사에 전략적 투자를 하기도 했어요.
body.en: Back in 2024, Microsoft even made a strategic investment in this company.
body.grammar: The particle -도 emphasizes the surprising or notable nature of the action ('even made an investment'). 지난 refers to the past year.

body.text: 새로운 합작법인은 고려아연의 자회사와 솔라사이클의 사업 부문 지분을 서로 출자하는 방식으로 만들어져요.
body.en: The new joint venture is created in a way where Korea Zinc's subsidiary and Solarcycle's business division shares are mutually invested.
body.grammar: The passive form 만들어져요 indicates creation. The pattern -(으)는 방식으로 means 'in the method of'.

body.text: 고려아연은 이번 합작을 통해 태양광 폐패널을 모으는 것부터 금속을 회수하는 것까지 이어지는 자원순환 사업을 강화할 계획이에요.
body.en: Through this joint venture, Korea Zinc plans to strengthen its resource circulation business, ranging from collecting waste solar panels to recovering metals.
body.grammar: The chained modifiers -는 것부터 and -는 것까지 express 'from doing... to doing...'. 계획이에요 states the future plan.

body.text: 태양광 패널 안에는 유리와 알루미늄뿐만 아니라 은과 구리 같은 귀한 금속도 들어 있어요.
body.en: Inside solar panels, not only glass and aluminum, but also precious metals like silver and copper are contained.
body.grammar: -뿐만 아니라 means 'not only... but also'. Like/such as is expressed through 같은.

body.text: 고려아연은 솔라사이클의 수거망을 이용해 폐패널을 안정적으로 확보하고 유가금속을 더 많이 회수하려고 해요.
body.en: Korea Zinc aims to use Solarcycle's collection network to stably secure waste panels and recover more valuable metals.
body.grammar: The ending -(으)려고 해요 expresses the subject's intent ('is trying to / plans to'). 안정적으로 turns the adjective into an adverb ('stably').

body.text: 특히 돈이 많이 드는 유리 분리 과정에 고려아연의 제련 기술을 도입해서 비용을 줄이고 수익을 높인다는 전략이에요.
body.en: In particular, the strategy is to introduce Korea Zinc's smelting technology to the expensive glass separation process to reduce costs and increase profits.
body.grammar: The modifier 돈이 많이 드는 ('that costs a lot of money') modifies 유리 분리 과정. The ending -(ㄴ)다는 전략이에요 explains the core strategy.

body.text: 전 세계적으로 태양광 발전이 늘어나면서 앞으로 버려지는 패널도 많아질 것으로 보여요.
body.en: As solar power generation increases worldwide, it is expected that discarded panels will also increase in the future.
body.grammar: The cause-and-effect connective -(으)면서 means 'while / as'. The future conjecture form -(으)ㄹ 것으로 보여요 means 'it is viewed/expected that...'.

body.text: 고려아연은 이 시장을 먼저 잡아서 성장할 수 있는 기반을 다지겠다는 입장을 밝혔어요.
body.en: Korea Zinc stated its position that it will secure this market first and lay the foundation for growth.
body.grammar: The future intent ending -(으)겠다는 marks direct thought/intent quoted inside the noun modifier phrase. 입장을 밝혔어요 means 'clarified its stance'.

title.text: Korea Zinc bildar ett samriskföretag med ett amerikanskt solcellsåtervinningsföretag
title.en: Korea Zinc forms a joint venture with an American solar recycling company
title.grammar: Compound noun structure in Swedish ('solcellsåtervinningsföretag') writes multiple nouns as one single word. Title case lacks final period.

body.text: Korea Zinc har börjat samarbeta med det amerikanska solcellsåtervinningsföretaget Solarcycle.
body.en: Korea Zinc has begun cooperating with the American solar recycling company Solarcycle.
body.grammar: Present perfect tense ('har börjat') followed by the infinitive 'samarbeta'. The definite adjective 'det amerikanska' agrees with the neuter noun.

body.text: Den 16 november skrev de avtal om att bilda samriskföretaget Jupiter.
body.en: On November 16 they wrote an agreement to form the joint venture Jupiter.
body.grammar: V2 word order places the past tense verb 'skrev' in second position after the introductory prepositional phrase 'Den 16 november'.

body.text: Solarcycle är känt för att samla in och återvinna gamla solpaneler i USA.
body.en: Solarcycle is known for collecting and recycling old solar panels in the USA.
body.grammar: The passive participle 'känd' is followed by 'för att' + infinitive to state what something is known for.

body.text: År 2024 gjorde Microsoft en investering i företaget.
body.en: In 2024, Microsoft made an investment in the company.
body.grammar: Inversion applies because the sentence starts with the time expression 'År 2024', placing the verb 'gjorde' before the subject 'Microsoft'.

body.text: Det nya bolaget skapas genom att företagen lägger in aktier från sina respektive verksamheter.
body.en: The new company is created by the companies contributing shares from their respective operations.
body.grammar: The passive construction 'skapas' indicates an ongoing or resulting passive process. 'genom att' introduces a clause explaining the method.

body.text: Genom det här samarbetet vill Korea Zinc bygga en hel kedja för återvinning.
body.en: Through this cooperation, Korea Zinc wants to build a complete chain for recycling.
body.grammar: Fronted prepositional phrase 'Genom det här samarbetet' triggers inversion, placing the modal verb 'vill' before the subject 'Korea Zinc'.

body.text: Kedjan börjar med insamling av gamla solpaneler och slutar med att man tar tillvara värdefulla metaller som silver och koppar.
body.en: The chain begins with collection of old solar panels and ends with recovering valuable metals like silver and copper.
body.grammar: The phrasal expression 'ta tillvara' means 'to salvage / make use of'. Parallel clauses are linked by 'och'.

body.text: Solarcycle har ett bra nätverk för att samla in paneler.
body.en: Solarcycle has a good network for collecting panels.
body.grammar: Standard declarative sentence with indefinite singular noun 'ett bra nätverk'.

body.text: På så sätt kan företagen få en stabil tillgång på material.
body.en: In that way, the companies can get a stable supply of material.
body.grammar: The modal verb 'kan' is followed by the bare infinitive 'få'. Inversion occurs because of the introductory phrase 'På så sätt'.

body.text: Korea Zinc planerar att använda sin egen teknik för att skilja glas från andra material.
body.en: Korea Zinc plans to use its own technology to separate glass from other materials.
body.grammar: 'sin egen teknik' uses the reflexive possessive pronoun 'sin' referring back to the subject Korea Zinc.

body.text: Det gör processen billigare och ökar vinsterna.
body.en: This makes the process cheaper and increases the profits.
body.grammar: Comparative adjectives 'billigare' (-are form) and verb forms 'gör' and 'ökar' construct a simple causal clause.

body.text: Eftersom solenergi blir vanligare i hela världen förväntas också mängden gamla paneler öka.
body.en: Since solar energy is becoming more common worldwide, the amount of old panels is also expected to increase.
body.grammar: Passive voice with infinitive 'förväntas öka' ('is expected to increase'). The subordinate clause starts with 'Eftersom' (Since).

body.text: Målet är att ta en stark position på marknaden tidigt för att säkra framtida tillväxt.
body.en: The goal is to take a strong position in the market early to secure future growth.
body.grammar: The infinitive phrase 'att ta en stark position' acts as the predicative complement following 'är'.

title.ko: 고려아연이 미국 회사와 새 회사를 만들어요
title.sv: Korea Zinc startar ett nytt företag i USA
title.en: Korea Zinc creates a new company in the USA

summary.ko: 고려아연이 미국 솔라사이클과 함께 새 회사를 만들어요. 이름은 주피터예요. 솔라사이클은 태양광 패널을 모으고 재활용하는 회사예요. 마이크로소프트도 이 회사에 투자했어요. 두 회사는 태양광 패널을 재활용하는 사업을 같이 해요. 패널을 모아서 좋은 금속을 다시 가져올 거예요. 고려아연의 기술로 비용을 줄이고 이익을 높일 거예요. 태양광 패널이 앞으로 더 많이 나올 것이기 때문이에요.
summary.sv: Korea Zinc startar ett nytt företag med amerikanska Solarcycle. Det nya företaget heter Jupiter. Solarcycle samlar in och återvinner solpaneler. Microsoft har också investerat i bolaget. De ska arbeta tillsammans med återvinning av solpaneler. De vill samla in paneler och ta tillbaka metaller. Korea Zinc vill använda sin teknik för att spara pengar. Det blir mer solpaneler i framtiden.
summary.en: Korea Zinc starts a new company with American Solarcycle. The new company is called Jupiter. Solarcycle collects and recycles solar panels. Microsoft has also invested in the company. They will work together on recycling solar panels. They want to collect panels and recover metals. Korea Zinc wants to use its technology to save money. There will be more solar panels in the future.

title.text: 고려아연이 미국 회사와 새 회사를 만들어요
title.en: Korea Zinc is making a new company with an American company
title.grammar: The topic marker -이 is attached to the subject 고려아연. The polite declarative ending -어요 is used to form a standard present tense sentence.

body.text: 고려아연이 미국 솔라사이클과 함께 새 회사를 만들어요.
body.en: Korea Zinc is making a new company together with American Solarcycle.
body.grammar: The particle -와/과 means 'with', reinforced here by the adverb 함께 meaning 'together'. The object particle -를 marks 회사를.

body.text: 이름은 주피터예요.
body.en: The name is Jupiter.
body.grammar: The topic is 이름 ('name'), and the copula 이에요/예요 is used for equating the subject with a noun (주피터예요).

body.text: 솔라사이클은 태양광 패널을 모으고 재활용하는 회사예요.
body.en: Solarcycle is a company that collects and recycles solar panels.
body.grammar: The modifier ending -는 turns the verbs 모으고 and 재활용하는 into relative clauses describing the noun 회사.

body.text: 마이크로소프트도 이 회사에 투자했어요.
body.en: Microsoft also invested in this company.
body.grammar: The particle -도 means 'also'. The locative particle -에 indicates direction/target of investment.

body.text: 두 회사는 태양광 패널을 재활용하는 사업을 같이 해요.
body.en: The two companies do the business of recycling solar panels together.
body.grammar: The adverb 같이 means 'together'. The noun modifier form 태양광 패널을 재활용하는 modifies 사업.

body.text: 패널을 모아서 좋은 금속을 다시 가져올 거예요.
body.en: They will collect panels and bring back good metals.
body.grammar: The connective ending -아서 indicates sequential action ('collect and then'). The future tense suffix -ㄹ 거예요 expresses intent.

body.text: 고려아연의 기술로 비용을 줄이고 이익을 높일 거예요.
body.en: With Korea Zinc's technology, they will reduce costs and increase profits.
body.grammar: The particle -(으)로 indicates means or method ('with/by means of'). Parallel verbs 줄이고 and 높일 connect the actions.

body.text: 태양광 패널이 앞으로 더 많이 나올 것이기 때문이에요.
body.en: This is because solar panels will come out more in the future.
body.grammar: The expression -(으)ㄹ 것이기 때문이에요 gives the reason ('because it is expected that...'). 앞으로 means 'in the future'.

title.text: Korea Zinc startar ett nytt företag i USA
title.en: Korea Zinc starts a new company in the USA
title.grammar: Standard declarative word order (Subject + Verb + Object + Adverbial). 'ett nytt företag' is neuter singular indefinite.

body.text: Korea Zinc startar ett nytt företag med amerikanska Solarcycle.
body.en: Korea Zinc starts a new company with American Solarcycle.
body.grammar: The preposition 'med' introduces an accompaniment phrase. 'amerikanska' is the definite/plural adjective form agreeing with the proper noun/company context.

body.text: Det nya företaget heter Jupiter.
body.en: The new company is called Jupiter.
body.grammar: 'Det nya företaget' uses the neuter definite form (företaget) combined with the definite adjective (nya).

body.text: Solarcycle samlar in och återvinner solpaneler.
body.en: Solarcycle collects and recycles solar panels.
body.grammar: Two verbs (samlar in, återvinner) share the same subject and are connected by 'och'.

body.text: Microsoft har också investerat i bolaget.
body.en: Microsoft has also invested in the company.
body.grammar: Present perfect tense formed with 'har' + past participle ('investerat'). 'också' places 'also' right after the auxiliary verb.

body.text: De ska arbeta tillsammans med återvinning av solpaneler.
body.en: They are going to work together with recycling of solar panels.
body.grammar: The modal construction 'ska arbeta' expresses future/intention. 'tillsammans med' means 'together with'.

body.text: De vill samla in paneler och ta tillbaka metaller.
body.en: They want to gather panels and take back metals.
body.grammar: Modal verb 'vill' is followed by infinitive verbs without 'att' (vill samla, ta).

body.text: Korea Zinc vill använda sin teknik för att spara pengar.
body.en: Korea Zinc wants to use its technology to save money.
body.grammar: The infinitive marker 'att' is used after the preposition 'för' in the phrase 'för att' (in order to).

body.text: Det blir mer solpaneler i framtiden.
body.en: There will be more solar panels in the future.
body.grammar: The impersonal 'Det blir' translates to 'There will be / becomes'. 'i framtiden' uses the definite form of framtid.

title.ko: 전직 국가안보보좌관이 대법원에 상고했어요
title.sv: Tidigare säkerhetsrådgivaren överklagar domen till Högsta domstolen
title.en: Former security advisor appeals ruling to the Supreme Court

summary.ko:
헨리 란데르홀름 전 국가안보보좌관이 대법원에 상고했어요. 그는 스베아 항소법원에서 유죄 판결을 받았어요.

그는 비밀 정보 취급 부주의 혐의로 5만 2천 크로나의 벌금형을 선고받았어요.

문제가 된 사건은 2023년 3월에 발생했어요. 그는 스톡홀름 북쪽에 있는 Gällöfsta 교육 시설의 금고에 비밀 문서를 두고 갔어요.

청소부가 이 기밀 서류들을 발견하면서 사건이 드러났어요. 문서 중 최소 하나는 나토 가입 과정에서의 대튀르키예 전략과 미국과의 비밀 회의에 관한 내용이었어요.

Attunda 지방법원은 처음에 그를 무죄로 석방했어요. 법원은 그에게 과실이 있었지만 중과실은 아니라고 판단했어요.

하지만 스베아 항소법원은 다른 판단을 내렸어요. 항소법원은 그가 중대한 과실로 기밀을 유출했다고 보았어요.

란데르홀름은 자신유죄를 부인해왔어요. 그는 정보가 특별히 민감하다는 사실을 몰랐다고 주장했어요.

이제 그는 항소법원의 판결에 불복해 대법원에 상고장을 제출했어요.
summary.sv:
Den tidigare nationella säkerhetsrådgivaren Henrik Landerholm överklagar sin dom till Högsta domstolen. Han dömdes tidigare av Svea hovrätt för vårdslöshet med hemlig uppgift.

Straffet blev 80 dagsböter på sammanlagt 52 000 kronor. Domen gäller hemliga dokument som glömdes kvar i ett värdeskåp.

Händelsen inträffade i mars 2023 på kursgården Gällöfsta norr om Stockholm. Dokumenten hittades av en städerska som slog larm.

Minst ett av dokumenten handlade om Sveriges strategi gentemot Turkiet i Natoprocessen. Det fanns också uppgifter om ett hemligt möte med USA.

Attunda tingsrätt friade honom tidigare från anklagelserna. Tingsrätten ansåg att han var oaktsam men inte tillräckligt oaktsam för en fällande dom.

Svea hovrätt gjorde däremot en helt annan bedömning. De ansåg att han hade röjt uppgifterna genom grov oaktsamhet.

Henrik Landerholm har hela tiden nekat till brott. Han har bland annat hävdat att han inte visste att informationen var så känslig.

Nu tar han ärendet vidare till Högsta domstolen för en sista prövning.
summary.en:
The former national security advisor Henrik Landerholm is appealing his sentence to the Supreme Court. He was previously convicted by the Svea Court of Appeal for careless handling of secret information.

The punishment was 80 daily fines totaling 52,000 kronor. The verdict concerns secret documents that were left behind in a safe.

The incident occurred in March 2023 at the Gällöfsta training center north of Stockholm. The documents were found by a cleaner who raised the alarm.

At least one of the documents concerned Sweden's strategy toward Turkey in the NATO process. There was also information about a secret meeting with the US.

The Attunda District Court previously acquitted him of the charges. The court considered that he was negligent but not negligent enough for a conviction.

The Svea Court of Appeal made a completely different assessment. They considered that he had disclosed the information through gross negligence.

Henrik Landerholm has denied the crime the whole time. He has argued, among other things, that he did not know the information was so sensitive.

Now he is taking the case further to the Supreme Court for a final review.

title.text: 전직 국가안보보좌관이 대법원에 상고했어요
title.en: Former national security advisor appealed to the Supreme Court
title.grammar: A compound title noun phrase ending with 상고했어요. 전직 means 'former'.

body.text: 헨리 란데르홀름 전 국가안보보좌관이 대법원에 상고했어요.
body.en: Former National Security Advisor Henrik Landerholm appealed to the Supreme Court.
body.grammar: Long appositive subject noun phrase followed by the locative and verb. The title acts as an apposition to the name.

body.text: 그는 스베아 항소법원에서 유죄 판결을 받았어요.
body.en: He was found guilty by the Svea Court of Appeal.
body.grammar: 스베아 항소법원에서 indicates the court where the conviction took place. 유죄 판결을 받았어요 means 'received a guilty verdict'.

body.text: 그는 비밀 정보 취급 부주의 혐의로 5만 2천 크로나의 벌금형을 선고받았어요.
body.en: He was sentenced to a fine of 52,000 kronor on charges of careless handling of secret information.
body.grammar: The complex noun modifier phrase 비밀 정보 취급 부주의 혐의로 uses 로 ('on charges of / with').

body.text: 문제가 된 사건은 2023년 3월에 발생했어요.
body.en: The incident in question occurred in March 2023.
body.grammar: The adjectival clause 문제가 된 modifies 사건 ('the incident that became an issue'). 발생했어요 is a formal past-tense verb meaning 'occurred'.

body.text: 그는 스톡홀름 북쪽에 있는 Gällöfsta 교육 시설의 금고에 비밀 문서를 두고 갔어요.
body.en: He left secret documents in the safe of the Gällöfsta educational facility north of Stockholm.
body.grammar: Complex location modifiers are stacked using location markers like 에 and modifying particles like 의.

body.text: 청소부가 이 기밀 서류들을 발견하면서 사건이 드러났어요.
body.en: The incident came to light as a cleaner discovered these classified documents.
body.grammar: The connective 아/어 가면서 or 면서 expresses simultaneous actions or overlapping events ('while / as [something] happened').

body.text: 문서 중 최소 하나는 나토 가입 과정에서의 대튀르키예 전략과 미국과의 비밀 회의에 관한 내용이었어요.
body.en: At least one of the documents concerned Turkey-related strategies in the NATO accession process and secret meetings with the United States.
body.grammar: The suffix 에 관한내용이었어요 means 'was about / concerned [topic]'. 최소 하나는 means 'at least one'.

body.text: Attunda 지방법원은 처음에 그를 무죄로 석방했어요.
body.en: Attunda District Court initially released him without charges / acquitted him.
body.grammar: 처음에 means 'initially/at first'. 무죄로 석방했어요 combines 무죄 (innocent) with 석방하다 (to release).

body.text: 법원은 그에게 과실이 있었지만 중과실은 아니라고 판단했어요.
body.en: The court judged that he had negligence, but it was not gross negligence.
body.grammar: The contrasting connective 지만 connects two clauses ('had negligence, but...'). 판단했어요 is the past tense of 판단하다 (to judge).

body.text: 하지만 스베아 항소법원은 다른 판단을 내렸어요.
body.en: However, the Svea Court of Appeal reached a different judgment.
body.grammar: 하지만 introduces the counterargument. 다른 판단을 내렸어요 uses 내리다 ('to hand down [a decision]').

body.text: 항소법원은 그가 중대한 과실로 기밀을 유출했다고 보았어요.
body.en: The appeals court considered that he leaked classified information through gross negligence.
body.grammar: The quotative construction 고 보았어요 attributes the opinion to the court. 기밀을 유출했다고 means 'that [he] leaked classified info'.

body.text: 란데르홀름은 자신유죄를 부인해왔어요.
body.en: Landerholm has been denying his guilt.
body.grammar: The continuous/ongoing state suffix 해왔어요 combines 하다 with 오다 to mean 'has been doing up to now'.

body.text: 그는 정보가 특별히 민감하다는 사실을 몰랐다고 주장했어요.
body.en: He claimed that he did not know the fact that the information was particularly sensitive.
body.grammar: The indirect quotation structure 몰랐다고 주장했어요 combines a negative verb form with 주장하다 ('claimed that [he] did not know').

body.text: 이제 그는 항소법원의 판결에 불복해 대법원에 상고장을 제출했어요.
body.en: Now he has submitted an appeal to the Supreme Court, objecting to the appeals court's verdict.
body.grammar: The adverbial participle 불복해 means 'disobeying / appealing against'. 상고장을 제출했어요 means 'submitted a notice of appeal'.

title.text: Tidigare säkerhetsrådgivaren överklagar domen till Högsta domstolen
title.en: Former security advisor appeals the verdict to the Supreme Court
title.grammar: A compound headline noun phrase with an agent noun ending in -en (definite form). Högsta domstolen is definite.

body.text: Den tidigare nationella säkerhetsrådgivaren Henrik Landerholm överklagar sin dom till Högsta domstolen.
body.en: The former national security advisor Henrik Landerholm is appealing his sentence to the Supreme Court.
body.grammar: Subject modifiers like tidigare and nationella precede the head noun. Reflexive possessive sin refers back to the subject.

body.text: Han dömdes tidigare av Svea hovrätt för vårdslöshet med hemlig uppgift.
body.en: He was previously convicted by Svea Court of Appeal for gross carelessness with secret information (negligence with secret data).
body.grammar: The past passive dömdes is followed by av (by) and för (for). Vårdslöshet med hemlig uppgift is a legal term.

body.text: Straffet blev 80 dagsböter på sammanlagt 52 000 kronor.
body.en: The punishment became 80 day-fines totaling 52,000 kronor.
body.grammar: Dagsböter is a specific Swedish penalty type (day-fines). På sammanlagt means 'totaling / in total'.

body.text: Domen gäller hemliga dokument som glömdes kvar i ett värdeskåp.
body.en: The verdict concerns secret documents that were left behind in a safe.
body.grammar: The relative clause som glömdes kvar uses a passive past form. Gäller means 'concerns / applies to'.

body.text: Händelsen inträffade i mars 2023 på kursgården Gällöfsta norr om Stockholm.
body.en: The event occurred in March 2023 at the Gällöfsta course center north of Stockholm.
body.grammar: Norr om means 'north of'. The relative/participial structure features a past tense verb inträffade.

body.text: Dokumenten hittades av en städerska som slog larm.
body.en: The documents were found by a cleaner who raised the alarm.
body.grammar: The idiom slå larm means 'to sound the alarm / raise the alarm'. Hittades is in the passive voice.

body.text: Minst ett av dokumenten handlade om Sveriges strategi gentemot Turkiet i Natoprocessen.
body.en: At least one of the documents was about Sweden's strategy toward Turkey in the NATO process.
body.grammar: Gentemot means 'towards / in relation to'. Natoprocessen is a compound noun in the definite form.

body.text: Det fanns också uppgifter om ett hemligt möte med USA.
body.en: There were also details about a secret meeting with the USA.
body.grammar: The existential construction Det fanns means 'There were / existed'. Uppgifter means 'information / details'.

body.text: Attunda tingsrätt friade honom tidigare från anklagelserna.
body.en: Attunda District Court previously acquitted him of the charges.
body.grammar: Friade... från means 'acquitted... from'. Anklagelserna is the plural definite form of anklagelse.

body.text: Tingsrätten ansåg att han var oaktsam men inte tillräckligt oaktsam för en fällande dom.
body.en: The district court considered that he was negligent but not negligent enough for a conviction.
body.grammar: The compound adjective fällande dom means 'a conviction / guilty verdict'. Ansåg takes an att-clause.

body.text: Svea hovrätt gjorde däremot en helt annan bedömning.
body.en: Svea Court of Appeal, on the other hand, made a completely different assessment.
body.grammar: Däremot is a conjunctive adverb indicating contrast ('on the other hand'). En helt annan bedömning uses an intensifier helt.

body.text: De ansåg att han hade röjt uppgifterna genom grov oaktsamhet.
body.en: They considered that he had disclosed the information through gross negligence.
body.grammar: The verb röja (to disclose/reveal) combines with genom grov oaktsamhet (through gross negligence).

body.text: Henrik Landerholm har hela tiden nekat till brott.
body.en: Henrik Landerholm has all along denied the crime.
body.grammar: The present perfect har hela tiden nekat expresses an action continuing from past to present.

body.text: Han har bland annat hävdat att han inte visste att informationen var så känslig.
body.en: He has, among other things, claimed that he did not know that the information was so sensitive.
body.grammar: The phrase bland annat means 'among other things'. Hävdat att means 'claimed that'.

body.text: Nu tar han ärendet vidare till Högsta domstolen för en sista prövning.
body.en: Now he is taking the case further to the Supreme Court for a final review/trial.
body.grammar: The phrasal verb ta... vidare means 'to take [something] further'. För en sista prövning means 'for a final trial/review'.

title.ko: 헨리 란데르홀름이 대법원에 상고했어요
title.sv: Landerholm överklagar till HD
title.en: Landerholm appeals to the Supreme Court

summary.ko:
헨리 란데르홀름이 유죄 판결을 받았어요. 그는 항소법원에서 벌금형을 선고받았어요. 그는 비밀 문서를 두고 갔어요.

사건은 2023년 3월에 일어났어요. 그는 스톡홀름 근처의 한 건물에 문서를 두고 갔어요. 청소부가 비밀 문서를 찾았어요.

하급 법원은 그를 무죄로 판결했어요. 하지만 항소법원은 다르게 생각했어요. 법원은 그가 중대한 과실을 저질렀다고 보았어요.

란데르홀름은 범죄를 부인했어요. 이제 그는 대법원에 판결을 다시 살펴봐달라고 요청했어요.
summary.sv:
Henrik Landerholm dömdes för ett brott. Hovrätten gav honom ett straff med böter. Han glömde hemliga papper på en kursgård.

Händelsen var i mars år 2023. En städerska hittade dokumenten i ett skåp. Pappersbunken handlade bland annat om Nato och USA.

En tingsrätt friade mannen tidigare. Men hovrätten gjorde en annan bedömning. De tyckte att han var grovt oaktsam.

Mannen har hela tiden nekat till brott. Nu vill han att Högsta domstolen ska pröva domen.
summary.en:
Henrik Landerholm was convicted of a crime. An appeals court gave him a fine. He left secret documents behind.

The event was in March 2023. A cleaner found the papers in a locker. The documents concerned Nato and the US among other things.

A lower court acquitted the man earlier. But the appeals court made a different assessment. They thought he was grossly negligent.

The man has denied the crime all along. Now he wants the Supreme Court to review the verdict.

title.text: 헨리 란데르홀름이 대법원에 상고했어요
title.en: Henrik Landerholm appealed to the Supreme Court
title.grammar: This is a title sentence ending in the past tense polite form (-어요). The subject is marked with the topic/subject particle 이.

body.text: 헨리 란데르홀름이 유죄 판결을 받았어요.
body.en: Henrik Landerholm was found guilty.
body.grammar: The verb phrase 유죄 판결을 받았어요 uses the noun 판결 (ruling/judgment) with the verb 받다 (to receive), meaning 'to receive a verdict'.

body.text: 그는 항소법원에서 벌금형을 선고받았어요.
body.en: He was sentenced to a fine in the appeals court.
body.grammar: The locative particle -에서 indicates the location where the action took place. 벌금형을 선고받다 means 'to be sentenced to a fine'.

body.text: 그는 비밀 문서를 두고 갔어요.
body.en: He left secret documents behind.
body.grammar: The connective -고 means 'and' or is used to chain actions. 두고 가다 literally means 'to leave behind while going'.

body.text: 사건은 2023년 3월에 일어났어요.
body.en: The incident happened in March 2023.
body.grammar: Time expressions like 년 (year) and 월 (month) are combined with numbers and followed by locative particles like 에.

body.text: 그는 스톡홀름 근처의 한 건물에 문서를 두고 갔어요.
body.en: He left documents in a building near Stockholm.
body.grammar: 근처의 means 'near' or 'vicinity of', modifying the following noun 건물 (building) with the possessive/modifying particle 의.

body.text: 청소부가 비밀 문서를 찾았어요.
body.en: A cleaner found the secret documents.
body.grammar: 청소부 is the subject performing the action, marked by the subject marker 이.

body.text: 하급 법원은 그를 무죄로 판결했어요.
body.en: The lower court ruled him innocent.
body.grammar: The construction 무죄로 (as not guilty) uses the transformitive particle 로 to indicate the state resulting from the ruling.

body.text: 하지만 항소법원은 다르게 생각했어요.
body.en: However, the appeals court thought differently.
body.grammar: 하지만 is a conjunctive adverb meaning 'however'. 다르게 is the adverbial form of 다르다 (to be different).

body.text: 법원은 그가 중대한 과실을 저질렀다고 보았어요.
body.en: The court considered that he had committed a serious negligence.
body.grammar: The quotation form 고 보았어요 embeds a clause with 고 to express the court's viewpoint or judgment.

body.text: 란데르홀름은 범죄를 부인했어요.
body.en: Landerholm denied the crime.
body.grammar: 부인했어요 takes an object marked with 을/를. The past tense marker 었 appears before the polite ending.

body.text: 이제 그는 대법원에 판결을 다시 살펴봐달라고 요청했어요.
body.en: Now he has asked the Supreme Court to look at the verdict again.
body.grammar: The complex request structure uses -달라고 요청했어요 ('asked [someone] to do [something] for [me/subject]'). 다시 means 'again'.

title.text: Landerholm överklagar till HD
title.en: Landerholm appeals to the Supreme Court
title.grammar: The verb överklagar is in the present tense. The preposition till introduces the destination of the appeal.

body.text: Henrik Landerholm dömdes för ett brott.
body.en: Henrik Landerholm was convicted of a crime.
body.grammar: The verb dömdes is in the passive past tense. The preposition för introduces the specific crime or charge.

body.text: Hovrätten gav honom ett straff med böter.
body.en: The appeals court gave him a penalty with fines.
body.grammar: Hovrätten is in the definite singular form. The indirect object honom (him) precedes the direct object ett straff.

body.text: Han glömde hemliga papper på en kursgård.
body.en: He forgot secret papers at a training center.
body.grammar: The verb glömde is in the past tense. Hemliga is the plural definite/adjectival form agreeing with papper.

body.text: Händelsen var i mars år 2023.
body.en: The event was in March in the year 2023.
body.grammar: The past tense of vara is var. Compound expressions like år 2023 specify the year.

body.text: En städerska hittade dokumenten i ett skåp.
body.en: A cleaner found the documents in a locker/cabinet.
body.grammar: En städerska is indefinite singular. Hittade is the past tense of hitta.

body.text: Pappersbunken handlade bland annat om Nato och USA.
body.en: The pile of papers was about, among other things, NATO and the USA.
body.grammar: The fixed phrase bland annat means 'among other things'. Handlade om means 'was about'.

body.text: En tingsrätt friade mannen tidigare.
body.en: A district court acquitted the man earlier.
body.grammar: Friade is the past tense of fria (to acquit). Tidigare is a comparative adverb meaning 'earlier'.

body.text: Men hovrätten gjorde en annan bedömning.
body.en: But the appeals court made a different assessment.
body.grammar: Men introduces a contrast. En annan bedömning uses the indefinite article en with the feminine noun bedömning.

body.text: De tyckte att han var grovt oaktsam.
body.en: They thought that he was grossly negligent.
body.grammar: The past tense tyckte takes an att-clause ('that he was...'). Grovt oaktsam combines an adverb with an adjective.

body.text: Mannen har hela tiden nekat till brott.
body.en: The man has all along denied the crime.
body.grammar: The present perfect tense har nekat is formed with har + past participle nekat. Neaka till is a phrasal construction meaning 'to deny'.

body.text: Nu vill han att Högsta domstolen ska pröva domen.
body.en: Now he wants the Supreme Court to examine the verdict.
body.grammar: The modal verb vill is followed by an infinitive without 'att' in some contexts, but here vill han att... ska pröva features an att-clause with the auxiliary ska.

title.ko: 중국 연구원들이 역대 최저 온도 기록을 깼어요
title.sv: Kinesiska forskare slår rekord med extrem kyla
title.en: Chinese researchers break record with extreme cold

summary.ko:
중국 연구원들이 절대영도에 아주 가까운 역대 최저 온도를 만들어냈어요. 이 실험은 중국의 톈궁 우주정거장에서 진행되었고 과학 잡지인 사이언스에도 소개되었어요.

연구원들은 레이저를 사용해 루비듐 원자 2천 개를 가두고 온도를 9.7피코켈빈까지 낮추었어요. 이는 1도 조각의 수조 분의 일 수준이며 2021년에 세워진 이전 기록의 네 분의 일에 불과해요.

절대영도는 0켈빈이며 섭씨 마이너스 273.15도에 해당해요. 물리 법칙에 따르면 원자의 진동이 완전히 멈추는 것은 불가능하기 때문에 이 온도는 이론적인 한계예요.

이번 연구에 참여한 학자들은 이번 기록이 극초냉가스와 입자의 성질을 연구할 수 있는 새로운 가능성을 열어준다고 말하고 있어요.
summary.sv:
Kinesiska forskare har skapat den kallaste temperaturen någonsin, mycket nära den absoluta nollpunkten. Tidskriften Science beskriver resultatet av experimentet som gjordes på den kinesiska rymdstationen Tiangong som en stor vetenskaplig framgång.

Med hjälp av laserstrålar lyckades forskarna fånga in rubidiumatomer och kyla ner dem till nio komma sju pikokelvin. Det är bara en fjärdedel av det tidigare rekordet från år 2021.

Den absoluta nollpunkten är noll Kelvin, vilket motsvarar minus 273,15 grader Celsius. Detta är en teoretisk gräns eftersom fysikens lagar inte tillåter att atomernas vibrationer stannar av helt.

Andra forskare gratulerar till bedriften och menar att detta ger nya möjligheter att studera ultrakalla gaser och hur partiklar beter sig nära den absoluta nollpunkten.
summary.en:
Chinese researchers have created the coldest temperature ever, very close to absolute zero. The magazine Science describes the result of the experiment performed on the Chinese space station Tiangong as a major scientific success.

Using laser beams, the researchers managed to trap rubidium atoms and cool them down to nine point seven picokelvin. This is only a quarter of the previous record from 2021.

Absolute zero is zero Kelvin, which corresponds to minus 273.15 degrees Celsius. This is a theoretical limit because the laws of physics do not allow the vibrations of atoms to stop completely.

Other researchers congratulate the team and state that this opens up new possibilities for studying ultracold gases and how particles behave near absolute zero.

title.text: 중국 연구원들이 역대 최저 온도 기록을 깼어요
title.en: Chinese researchers broke the record for the lowest temperature in history
title.grammar: Compound noun '역대 최저 온도 기록' links multiple nouns together. The verb '깨다' takes the polite past tense ending '-었어요'.

body.text: 중국 연구원들이 절대영도에 아주 가까운 역대 최저 온도를 만들어냈어요.
body.en: Chinese researchers created the lowest temperature in history, very close to absolute zero.
body.grammar: The connective verb form '-어내다' emphasizes successfully completing an action ('만들어내다'). '아주 가까운' modifies '온도를'.

body.text: 이 실험은 중국의 톈궁 우주정거장에서 진행되었고 과학 잡지인 사이언스에도 소개되었어요.
body.en: This experiment was conducted at China's Tiangong space station and was also introduced in the science magazine Science.
body.grammar: The connective particle '-고' links two clauses together. Both verbs use passive endings ('진행되다', '소개되다') in the past tense.

body.text: 연구원들은 레이저를 사용해 루비듐 원자 2천 개를 가두고 온도를 9.7피코켈빈까지 낮추었어요.
body.en: The researchers used a laser to trap 2,000 rubidium atoms and lowered the temperature to 9.7 picokelvin.
body.grammar: The instrumental marker '-로' in '레이저를 사용해' means 'by using'. The connective suffix '-고' connects the actions of trapping and lowering.

body.text: 이는 1도 조각의 수조 분의 일 수준이며 2021년에 세워진 이전 기록의 네 분의 일에 불과해요.
body.en: This is a trillionth of a single degree and amounts to only a quarter of the previous record set in 2021.
body.grammar: The pronoun '이는' (this is) links clauses. '불과해요' expresses that something is merely a certain fraction or amount.

body.text: 절대영도는 0켈빈이며 섭씨 마이너스 273.15도에 해당해요.
body.en: Absolute zero is 0 Kelvin and corresponds to minus 273.15 degrees Celsius.
body.grammar: The copula suffix '-이며' connects two equal statements. '해당해요' means 'corresponds to'.

body.text: 물리 법칙에 따르면 원자의 진동이 완전히 멈추는 것은 불가능하기 때문에 이 온도는 이론적인 한계예요.
body.en: Because physical laws state that it is impossible for atomic vibration to stop completely, this temperature is a theoretical limit.
body.grammar: The causal connective '-기 때문에' means 'because'. The nominalizing suffix '-는 것' turns the verb phrase into a noun clause.

body.text: 이번 연구에 참여한 학자들은 이번 기록이 극초냉가스와 입자의 성질을 연구할 수 있는 새로운 가능성을 열어준다고 말하고 있어요.
body.en: Scholars participating in this research say that this record opens up new possibilities to study ultracold gases and particle properties.
body.grammar: The indirect quotation form '-고 말하고 있어요' (are saying that) expresses ongoing discourse. The relative clause modifier '참여한' modifies '학자들은'.

title.text: Kinesiska forskare slår rekord med extrem kyla
title.en: Chinese researchers break records with extreme cold
title.grammar: Headline style using the present tense 'slår' for vivid reporting. The prepositional phrase 'med extrem kyla' modifies the verb phrase.

body.text: Kinesiska forskare har skapat den kallaste temperaturen någonsin, mycket nära den absoluta nollpunkten.
body.en: Chinese researchers have created the coldest temperature ever, very close to absolute zero.
body.grammar: The present perfect tense 'har skapat' combines the auxiliary 'har' with the supine 'skapat'. The adjectival phrase 'mycket nära' modifies the preceding clause.

body.text: Tidskriften Science beskriver resultatet av experimentet som gjordes på den kinesiska rymdstationen Tiangong som en stor vetenskaplig framgång.
body.en: The journal Science describes the result of the experiment conducted on the Chinese space station Tiangong as a major scientific success.
body.grammar: Long sentence featuring a relative clause ('som gjordes...') modifying 'experimentet'. The structure uses the phrasal verb 'beskriver [A] som [B]'.

body.text: Med hjälp av laserstrålar lyckades forskarna fånga in rubidiumatomer och kyla ner dem till nio komma sju pikokelvin.
body.en: Using laser beams, the researchers succeeded in trapping rubidium atoms and cooling them down to nine point seven picokelvin.
body.grammar: The phrase 'Med hjälp av' means 'with the help of'. 'Lyckades fånga in' uses the past tense of 'lyckas' followed by the infinitive.

body.text: Det är bara en fjärdedel av det tidigare rekordet från år 2021.
body.en: It is only a quarter of the previous record from the year 2021.
body.grammar: The phrase 'Det är bara' introduces a limiting statement. 'Fjärdedel' means a quarter.

body.text: Den absoluta nollpunkten är noll Kelvin, vilket motsvarar minus 273,15 grader Celsius.
body.en: Absolute zero is zero Kelvin, which corresponds to minus 273.15 degrees Celsius.
body.grammar: The relative pronoun 'vilket' refers back to the entire preceding clause. 'Motsvarar' means corresponds to.

body.text: Detta är en teoretisk gräns eftersom fysikens lagar inte tillåter att atomernas vibrationer stannar av helt.
body.en: This is a theoretical limit because the laws of physics do not allow the atomic vibrations to stop completely.
body.grammar: V2 word order places the finite verb 'är' in second position in the main clause. The subordinate clause introduced by 'eftersom' features standard Swedish subordinate clause word order.

body.text: Andra forskare gratulerar till bedriften och menar att detta ger nya möjligheter att studera ultrakalla gaser och hur partiklar beter sig nära den absoluta nollpunkten.
body.en: Other researchers congratulate on the achievement and mean that this gives new opportunities to study ultracold gases and how particles behave near absolute zero.
body.grammar: Complex sentence with nested clauses. 'Gratulerar till' is a fixed verb-preposition combination. 'Menar att' means 'is of the opinion that / maintains that'.

title.ko: 역사상 가장 추운 온도가 만들어졌어요
title.sv: Nytt rekord: Kallaste temperaturen någonsin
title.en: New record: The coldest temperature ever

summary.ko:
중국 연구원들이 역사상 가장 추운 온도를 만들었어요. 중국의 우주정거장에서 실험을 진행했어요.

연구원들은 루비듐 원자를 아주 차갑게 만들었어요. 온도는 9.7피코켈빈으로 떨어졌어요.

이것은 2021년의 이전 기록보다 네 배 더 차가워요. 과학 잡지인 사이언스도 이 결과를 칭찬했어요.
summary.sv:
Kinesiska forskare har skapat en ny rekordkyla. Experimentet gjordes på den kinesiska rymdstationen Tiangong.

Forskarna kylde ner atomer av ämnet rubidium. Temperaturen blev nio komma sju pikokelvin.

Det är det kallaste som någonsin har mätts upp. Rekordet från 2021 är därmed slaget.
summary.en:
Chinese researchers have created a new record cold. The experiment was made on the Chinese space station Tiangong.

The researchers cooled down atoms of rubidium. The temperature reached nine point seven picokelvin.

This is the coldest temperature ever measured. The previous record from 2021 is thus beaten.

title.text: 역사상 가장 추운 온도가 만들어졌어요
title.en: The coldest temperature in history was created
title.grammar: The title uses the polite past tense ending '-었어요' on the verb '만들다' (to make), combined with the passive marker '-어지다' to mean 'was made'. '가장' means 'most' and modifies the modifier '추운' (cold).

body.text: 중국 연구원들이 역사상 가장 추운 온도를 만들었어요.
body.en: Chinese researchers created the coldest temperature in history.
body.grammar: The subject marker '-들이' pluralizes '연구원' (researcher). The object marker '-을' marks '온도' as the direct object of the past tense verb '만들었어요'.

body.text: 중국의 우주정거장에서 실험을 진행했어요.
body.en: They conducted the experiment at China's space station.
body.grammar: The location particle '-에서' indicates where the action took place. The sentence uses the polite past tense ending '-었어요'.

body.text: 연구원들은 루비듐 원자를 아주 차갑게 만들었어요.
body.en: The researchers made rubidium atoms very cold.
body.grammar: The adverb '아주' (very) modifies the adjective '차갑게' (coldly/to a cold state), which functions adverbially with the verb '만들었어요' (made).

body.text: 온도는 9.7피코켈빈으로 떨어졌어요.
body.en: The temperature dropped to 9.7 picokelvin.
body.grammar: The target particle '-으로' indicates the direction of change or the resulting state. The verb '떨어지다' means 'to drop' or 'fall'.

body.text: 이것은 2021년의 이전 기록보다 네 배 더 차가워요.
body.en: This is four times colder than the previous record from 2021.
body.grammar: Comparison is expressed with the structure '[X]보다' (than [X]). '네 배' means 'four times'.

body.text: 과학 잡지인 사이언스도 이 결과를 칭찬했어요.
body.en: The science magazine Science also praised this result.
body.grammar: The particle '도' means 'also' or 'too'. The noun modifier '인' connects the noun '잡지' (magazine) to its appositive description '사이언스' (Science).

title.text: Nytt rekord: Kallaste temperaturen någonsin
title.en: New record: Coldest temperature ever
title.grammar: Headline style omitting auxiliary verbs. The superlative adjective 'kallaste' takes the definite ending '-n' when used attributively.

body.text: Kinesiska forskare har skapat en ny rekordkyla.
body.en: Chinese researchers have created a new record cold.
body.grammar: The present perfect tense is formed with the auxiliary 'har' plus the supine verb form 'skapat'. Word order is Subject-Verb-Object (SVO).

body.text: Experimentet gjordes på den kinesiska rymdstationen Tiangong.
body.en: The experiment was done on the Chinese space station Tiangong.
body.grammar: The passive voice is formed by adding '-s' to the infinitive form 'göra' (becoming 'gjordes'). Compound proper nouns follow standard capitalization rules.

body.text: Forskarna kylde ner atomer av ämnet rubidium.
body.en: The researchers cooled down atoms of the element rubidium.
body.grammar: The particle verb 'kyla ner' (to cool down) splits in certain constructions, but here 'kylde ner' appears intact in the past tense. 'Ämnet' is in the definite neuter form.

body.text: Temperaturen blev nio komma sju pikokelvin.
body.en: The temperature became nine point seven picokelvin.
body.grammar: Numbers are spelled out in lower case. 'Blev' is the past tense of 'bli' (to become).

body.text: Det är det kallaste som någonsin har mätts upp.
body.en: It is the coldest that has ever been measured.
body.grammar: The superlative 'kallaste' is followed by a relative clause introduced by 'som'. 'Har mätts upp' is a passive present perfect construction.

body.text: Rekordet från 2021 är därmed slaget.
body.en: The record from 2021 is thus beaten.
body.grammar: The adverb 'därmed' (thus/thereby) occupies the middle field after the finite verb in a fronted adverbial structure. 'Slaget' is the past participle of 'slå' functioning predicatively.

title.ko: 스웨덴 정치의 최신 소식과 앞으로의 일정이에요
title.sv: De senaste politiska turerna – och det som väntar nu
title.en: The latest political turns – and what awaits now

summary.ko:
스웨덴 정당들의 최근 움직임과 앞으로의 정치 일정에 대한 소식이에요.

지난 금요일 사회민주당과 온건당은 중도당에 정치적 제안을 전달했어요. 격렬한 협상 끝에 중도당 대표 엘리사베트 탄드 링크비스트는 사회민주당 쪽을 선택했다고 밝혔어요.

중도당은 사회민주당, 녹색당과 함께 정부를 구성하고 좌파당을 외부에서 지원 세력으로 두는 방향으로 협상을 진행하고 싶어 해요.

하지만 중도당은 좌파당에 대한 거부 선을 유지하고 있어요. 반면 좌파당은 정부 내 장관직 요구를 철회하지 않겠다고 밝혔어요. 중도당은 사회민주당의 약속을 믿는다고 말했어요.

온건당 대표 울프 크리스테르손은 당의 문이 열려 있다고 말했어요. 그는 화요일까지 탈만에게 조사 임무를 보고해야 해요. 이번 주에 새로운 총리 투표가 열릴 가능성이 있어요.
summary.sv:
Svensk politik är i ett intensivt läge med nya besked om regeringsfrågan. I fredags lämnade Socialdemokraterna och Moderaterna in sina politiska paket till Centerpartiet.

Efter helgens förhandlingar meddelade Centerpartiets ledare Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist att partiet har valt att gå vidare med Socialdemokraterna. De vill förhandla om en regering bestående av S, C och Miljöpartiet, med Vänsterpartiet som stödparti.

Beslutet togs efter möten på hemlig ort. Socialdemokraternas paket innehåller bland annat vinststopp i skolan och lättnader för jordbruket.

Samtidigt står Vänsterpartiet fast vid sitt krav på ministerposter i en regering. Centerpartiet säger att de förutsätter att Vänsterpartiet släpper det kravet. Moderatledaren Ulf Kristersson säger att dörren till Centerpartiet fortfarande är öppen.

Senast på tisdag ska Kristersson redovisa sitt uppdrag för talmannen Andreas Norlén. Det kan bli en ny statsministeromröstning i riksdagen redan i veckan. Om kandidater faller i uppemot fyra omröstningar kan det bli extraval.
summary.en:
Swedish politics is in an intensive phase with new announcements regarding the government. On Friday, the Social Democrats and the Moderates submitted their political packages to the Centre Party.

After weekend negotiations, Centre Party leader Elisabeth Thand Ringqvist announced that the party has chosen to proceed with the Social Democrats. They want to negotiate a government consisting of the Social Democrats, the Centre Party, and the Green Party, with the Left Party as an outside supporting party.

The decision followed meetings at a secret location. The Social Democrats' package includes items such as a profit ban in schools and relief for agriculture.

At the same time, the Left Party stands firm on its demand for ministerial posts in a government. The Centre Party says it assumes the Left Party will drop that demand. Moderate leader Ulf Kristersson says the door to the Centre Party is still open.

No later than Tuesday, Kristersson must report his exploratory assignment to Speaker Andreas Norlén. There could be a new prime minister vote in parliament this week. If candidates fail in up to four rounds of voting, a snap election may be called.

title.ko: 새 정부 구성을 위한 협상이 아직 어려운 상태예요
title.sv: Källor: Regeringsfrågan långt ifrån löst
title.en: Sources: The government question is far from resolved

summary.ko:
새로운 정부를 만들기 위한 협상이 아직 많이 남았어요. 좌파당은 부자세, 저렴한 음식, 복지 노동자 임금 인상 같은 무거운 요구를 하고 있어요.

중앙당 대표는 사회민주당의 방식을 선호한다고 밝혔어요. 하지만 좌파당은 반드시 정부에 들어가야 한다고 주장하고 있어요. 사회민주당은 좌파당이 장관 자리를 포기하도록 계속 설득하고 있어요.

사회민주당은 다른 대안도 고민하고 있어요. 반면에 환경당은 협상 결과에 대해 비교적 긍정적인 입장이에요. 하지만 정책 내용에서는 아직 의견이 많이 갈리고 있어요.
summary.sv:
Vänsterpartiet ställer tunga krav inför de kommande förhandlingarna om en ny regering. De kräver bland annat miljardärsskatt, billigare mat och höjda löner för välfärdsarbetare.

Centerpartiet föredrar Socialdemokraternas upplägg för hur Sverige ska styras. Samtidigt står Vänsterpartiet fast vid sitt krav på att få ingå fullt ut i regeringen med ministerposter. Socialdemokraterna försöker nu hitta andra lösningar för att nå en överenskommelse.

Miljöpartiet är mer positiva till resultatet av förra veckans överläggningar och ser en chans att komma vidare. Men när det gäller sakpolitiken är det fortfarande långt kvar till en lösning som alla partier är överens om.
summary.en:
Negotiations to form a new government are facing major hurdles. The Left Party is demanding a billionaire tax, cheaper food, and higher wages for welfare workers.

The Centre Party prefers the Social Democrats' plan for governing Sweden. Meanwhile, the Left Party insists on having cabinet seats in the government. The Social Democrats are trying to find alternative ways to reach an agreement.

The Green Party is more positive about the talks and sees a chance to move forward. However, on specific policy issues, the parties are still far from reaching a complete agreement.

title.text: 새 정부 구성을 위한 협상이 아직 어려운 상태예요
title.en: Negotiations to form a new government are still in a difficult state.
title.grammar: Noun-modifying form '구성을 위한' (for the purpose of forming). The noun phrase ends with '상태예요' (it is a state).

body.text: 새로운 정부를 만들기 위한 협상이 아직 많이 남았어요.
body.en: Negotiations to create a new government still have a long way to go.
body.grammar: '만들기 위한' means 'in order to make'. The idiom '많이 남았어요' means 'a lot remains'.

body.text: 좌파당은 부자세, 저렴한 음식, 복지 노동자 임금 인상 같은 무거운 요구를 하고 있어요.
body.en: The Left Party is making heavy demands such as a wealth tax, affordable food, and wage increases for welfare workers.
body.grammar: Listing items uses '같은' (such as). Compound nouns include '부자세' (wealth tax) and '임금 인상' (wage increase).

body.text: 중앙당 대표는 사회민주당의 방식을 선호한다고 밝혔어요.
body.en: The Center Party representative stated that they prefer the Social Democratic Party's method.
body.grammar: Indirect quotation using '다고 밝혔어요' (stated that). '선호한다' means 'to prefer'.

body.text: 하지만 좌파당은 반드시 정부에 들어가야 한다고 주장하고 있어요.
body.en: However, the Left Party is insisting that they must enter the government.
body.grammar: Strong obligation ending '야 한다고' (must do, quoted).

body.text: 사회민주당은 좌파당이 장관 자리를 포기하도록 계속 설득하고 있어요.
body.en: The Social Democrats are continuing to persuade the Left Party to give up cabinet positions.
body.grammar: The connective '도록' means 'so that' or 'to make someone do'. '포기하다' means 'to give up'.

body.text: 사회민주당은 다른 대안도 고민하고 있어요.
body.en: The Social Democratic Party is also considering other alternatives.
body.grammar: '도' attached to '대안' means 'also' or 'even'. '고민하고 있어요' means 'is pondering/considering'.

body.text: 반면에 환경당은 협상 결과에 대해 비교적 긍정적인 입장이에요.
body.en: On the other hand, the Green Party has a relatively positive stance on the negotiation results.
body.grammar: '반면에' introduces a contrast. '입장이에요' means 'is in a position/stance'.

body.text: 하지만 정책 내용에서는 아직 의견이 많이 갈리고 있어요.
body.en: However, opinions are still sharply divided regarding policy content.
body.grammar: Passive verb '갈리고 있어요' (are being divided). '내용에서는' combines noun, particle '에서', and topic marker '는'.

title.text: Källor: Regeringsfrågan långt ifrån löst
title.en: Sources: The government formation issue far from resolved.
title.grammar: News style headline omitting the copula verb 'är'. Compound noun 'Regeringsfrågan'.

body.text: Vänsterpartiet ställer tunga krav inför de kommande förhandlingarna om en ny regering.
body.en: The Left Party is making heavy demands ahead of the upcoming negotiations for a new government.
body.grammar: Verbal phrase 'ställer tunga krav' (makes heavy demands). Participle adjective 'kommande' (upcoming).

body.text: De kräver bland annat miljardärsskatt, billigare mat och höjda löner för välfärdsarbetare.
body.en: They demand, among other things, a billionaire tax, cheaper food, and increased wages for welfare workers.
body.grammar: The expression 'bland annat' means 'among other things'. Compound nouns include 'miljardärsskatt' and 'välfärdsarbetare'.

body.text: Centerpartiet föredrar Socialdemokraternas upplägg för hur Sverige ska styras.
body.en: The Center Party prefers the Social Democrats' setup for how Sweden is to be governed.
body.grammar: Verb 'föredrar' (prefers). Subordinate clause introduced by 'för hur'.

body.text: Samtidigt står Vänsterpartiet fast vid sitt krav på att få ingå fullt ut i regeringen med ministerposter.
body.en: At the same time, the Left Party stands firm on its demand to be fully included in the government with cabinet posts.
body.grammar: Adverbial phrase 'Samtidigt'. Verb phrase 'står fast vid' (stands firm on). Reflexive pronoun 'sig' in 'få ingå'.

body.text: Socialdemokraterna försöker nu hitta andra lösningar för att nå en överenskommelse.
body.en: The Social Democrats are now trying to find other solutions to reach an agreement.
body.grammar: Present participle/infinitive combination 'för att nå' (in order to reach). 'försöker nu hitta' uses V2 word order.

body.text: Miljöpartiet är mer positiva till resultatet av förra veckans överläggningar och ser en chans att komma vidare.
body.en: The Green Party is more positive about the results of last week's deliberations and sees a chance to move forward.
body.grammar: Genitive noun phrase 'förra veckans'. Conjunction 'och' connects two main clauses sharing the subject.

body.text: Men när det gäller sakpolitiken är det fortfarande långt kvar till en lösning som alla partier är överens om.
body.en: But when it comes to substantive politics, there is still a long way to go until a solution that all parties agree on.
body.grammar: The expression 'när det gäller' means 'when it comes to'. The relative clause 'som alla partier är överens om' modifies 'lösning'.

title.ko: 정부 구성 문제가 아직 멀었어요
title.sv: Regeringsfrågan är långt ifrån löst
title.en: The government question is far from solved

summary.ko:
좌파당이 정부에 들어가고 싶어 해요. 하지만 사회민주당은 그것을 원하지 않아요. 그래서 협상이 아주 어려워요.

중앙당은 사회민주당의 방식을 좋아해요. 하지만 좌파당은 장관 자리를 원해요. 그들은 요구를 바꾸지 않겠다고 말했어요.

사회민주당은 다른 해결책을 찾고 있어요. 환경당은 협상에 대해 더 긍정적이에요. 하지만 모든 정당이 아직 동의하지 않았어요.
summary.sv:
Vänsterpartiet vill ha ministerposter i en ny regering. Men Socialdemokraterna vill inte det. Partierna är oense.

Centerpartiet gillar Socialdemokraternas upplägg för hur Sverige ska styras. Vänsterpartiet säger nej och står på sig.

Miljöpartiet är mer positiva till fortsatta samtal. Men mycket arbete återstår innan alla partier är överens.
summary.en:
The Left Party wants to be in the government. However, the Social Democrats do not want that. The negotiations are very difficult.

The Centre Party prefers the Social Democrats' approach. But the Left Party demands cabinet seats and refuses to back down.

The Social Democrats are trying to find new solutions. The Green Party is more positive about the talks. Still, all parties are far from a final agreement.

title.text: 정부 구성 문제가 아직 멀었어요
title.en: The issue of forming a government is still far off.
title.grammar: Subject particle '이' attaches to '문제'. The ending '어요' forms polite present tense.

body.text: 좌파당이 정부에 들어가고 싶어 해요.
body.en: The Left Party wants to enter the government.
body.grammar: The auxiliary verb construction '고 싶어 하다' expresses someone else's desire. The object particle '을' marks '정부에' (locative).

body.text: 하지만 사회민주당은 그것을 원하지 않아요.
body.en: But the Social Democratic Party does not want that.
body.grammar: Conjunction '하지만' starts the contrast. '원하지 않아요' is the polite negative form of '원하다'.

body.text: 그래서 협상이 아주 어려워요.
body.en: Therefore, the negotiations are very difficult.
body.grammar: '그래서' links cause and effect. '어려워요' is the polite form of the irregular adjective '어렵다'.

body.text: 중앙당은 사회민주당의 방식을 좋아해요.
body.en: The Center Party likes the Social Democratic Party's method.
body.grammar: The possessive particle '의' connects '사회민주당' and '방식'. '좋아해요' means 'likes'.

body.text: 하지만 좌파당은 장관 자리를 원해요.
body.en: However, the Left Party wants cabinet positions.
body.grammar: '자리' literally means seat or place, used here metaphorically for political positions.

body.text: 그들은 요구를 바꾸지 않겠다고 말했어요.
body.en: They said they will not change their demands.
body.grammar: Reported speech structure using '고 말했어요'. The future negative form '지 않겠다고' expresses intention.

body.text: 사회민주당은 다른 해결책을 찾고 있어요.
body.en: The Social Democratic Party is looking for another solution.
body.grammar: The continuous tense ending '고 있어요' attaches to '찾다'.

body.text: 환경당은 협상에 대해 더 긍정적이에요.
body.en: The Green Party is more positive about the negotiations.
body.grammar: '에 대해' means 'regarding' or 'about'. '더' is an adverb meaning 'more'.

body.text: 하지만 모든 정당이 아직 동의하지 않았어요.
body.en: However, not all political parties have agreed yet.
body.grammar: Negative past tense '않았어요' attaches to '동의하다'. '모든' means 'all'.

title.text: Regeringsfrågan är långt ifrån löst
title.en: The government formation issue is far from resolved.
title.grammar: Compound noun 'Regeringsfrågan'. The phrase 'långt ifrån' means 'far from'.

body.text: Vänsterpartiet vill ha ministerposter i en ny regering.
body.en: The Left Party wants cabinet posts in a new government.
body.grammar: Modal verb 'vill' followed by infinitive 'ha'. Indefinite plural 'ministerposter'.

body.text: Men Socialdemokraterna vill inte det.
body.en: But the Social Democrats do not want that.
body.grammar: Definite plural noun 'Socialdemokraterna'. 'inte det' acts as the object.

body.text: Partierna är oense.
body.en: The parties are in disagreement.
body.grammar: Plural subject 'Partierna' with definite ending '-a'. Predicative adjective 'oense' (disagreeing).

body.text: Centerpartiet gillar Socialdemokraternas upplägg för hur Sverige ska styras.
body.en: The Center Party likes the Social Democrats' setup for how Sweden is to be governed.
body.grammar: Genitive form 'Socialdemokraternas'. Passive infinitive 'ska styras' (is to be governed).

body.text: Vänsterpartiet säger nej och står på sig.
body.en: The Left Party says no and stands its ground.
body.grammar: Idiomatic expression 'stå på sig' (to stand one's ground). Conjunction 'och' links two verbs.

body.text: Miljöpartiet är mer positiva till fortsatta samtal.
body.en: The Green Party is more positive toward continued talks.
body.grammar: Comparative adjective 'mer' with 'positiva'. Preposition 'till' governs 'fortsatta samtal'.

body.text: Men mycket arbete återstår innan alla partier är överens.
body.en: But much work remains before all parties are agreed.
body.grammar: Inverted word order after 'Men'. Deponent verb 'återstår' (remains).

title.ko: 정부 구성을 위한 사회민주당과 좌파당의 새로운 만남
title.sv: S och V i nytt möte för att diskutera regeringsfrågan
title.en: S and V in new meeting to discuss the government issue

summary.ko:
사회민주당 대표 마그달레나 안데르손과 좌파당 대표 누시 다드고스타가 월요일 오전에 만났어요. 두 사람은 사회민주당 국회 사무실에서 약 두 시간 동안 회의를 열었어요.

사회민주당의 목표는 좌파당이 정부 참여 요구를 철회하도록 하는 것이에요. 하지만 두 당의 입장 차이는 여전히 좁혀지지 않고 있어요.

센터파티가 사회민주당의 제안을 받아들이면서 네 개 정당 모두 대화에 참여하게 되었어요. 사회민주당은 모든 정당이 대화 테이블에 앉게 된 것을 긍정적으로 평가하고 있어요.

회의가 끝난 후 좌파당 측은 기존 입장에 변화가 없다고 밝혔어요. 좌파당은 모든 유권자의 표가 동등하게 존중되어야 한다고 강조하고 있어요.
summary.sv:
Socialdemokraternas partiledare Magdalena Andersson och Vänsterpartiets ledare Nooshi Dadgostar träffades på måndagsförmiddagen. Mötet hölls i riksdagskansliet och varade i ungefär två timmar för att diskutera regeringsfrågan.

Målet för Socialdemokraterna är att få Vänsterpartiet att backa från sitt krav på ministerposter. Låsningen mellan partierna ligger dock kvar efter mötet.

Efter att Centerpartiet ställt sig bakom Socialdemokraternas förslag sitter nu alla fyra rödgröna partier vid förhandlingsbordet. Socialdemokraterna beskriver det som väldigt positivt att alla parter pratar med varandra.

Efter mötet var Vänsterpartiet fåordiga om innehållet i samtalen. Partiet upprepar att deras ståndpunkt är oförändrad och att alla röster borde räknas på samma sätt.
summary.en:
Socialdemokraterna leader Magdalena Andersson and Vänsterpartiet leader Nooshi Dadgostar met on Monday morning. The meeting was held at the parliament office and lasted for about two hours to discuss the government issue.

The goal for Socialdemokraterna is to get Vänsterpartiet to back down from its demand for cabinet posts. However, the deadlock between the parties remains after the meeting.

After Centerpartiet accepted Socialdemokraterna's proposal, all four red-green parties are now at the negotiating table. Socialdemokraterna describes it as very positive that all parties are talking to each other.

After the meeting, Vänsterpartiet was tight-lipped about the contents of the talks. The party reiterates that their stance is unchanged and that all votes should count the same way.

title.text: 정부 구성을 위한 사회민주당과 좌파당의 새로운 만남
title.en: A new meeting between the Social Democrats and the Left Party for government formation
title.grammar: Compound noun phrase using the attributive nouns '정부 구성' and the modifying form '위한' (for the sake of).

body.text: 사회민주당 대표 마그달레나 안데르손과 좌파당 대표 누시 다드고스타가 월요일 오전에 만났어요.
body.en: Social Democratic leader Magdalena Andersson and Left Party leader Nooshi Dadgostar met on Monday morning.
body.grammar: The time expression '월요일 오전에' uses '에' to designate the specific time of occurrence.

body.text: 두 사람은 사회민주당 국회 사무실에서 약 두 시간 동안 회의를 열었어요.
body.en: The two people held a meeting for about two hours at the Social Democratic parliamentary office.
body.grammar: '약' means 'about/approximately'. '국회 사무실에서' uses '에서' to indicate the location where an action took place.

body.text: 사회민주당의 목표는 좌파당이 정부 참여 요구를 철회하도록 하는 것이에요.
body.en: The goal of the Social Democrats is to have the Left Party withdraw its demand to participate in the government.
body.grammar: The causative structure '하도록 하는 것이에요' means 'is to make [someone] do'.

body.text: 하지만 두 당의 입장 차이는 여전히 좁혀지지 않고 있어요.
body.en: However, the difference in positions between the two parties is still not narrowing.
body.grammar: '여전히' means 'still' or 'as before'. '좁혀지지 않고 있어요' is the passive progressive form meaning 'is not being narrowed'.

body.text: 센터파티가 사회민주당의 제안을 받아들이면서 네 개 정당 모두 대화에 참여하게 되었어요.
body.en: As the Center Party accepted the Social Democrats' proposal, all four parties came to participate in the dialogue.
body.grammar: The connective '면서/으면서' means 'while' or 'as'. '게 되었어요' expresses a resulting change of state ('came to be').

body.text: 사회민주당은 모든 정당이 대화 테이블에 앉게 된 것을 긍정적으로 평가하고 있어요.
body.en: The Social Democrats are positively evaluating the fact that all parties have come to sit at the dialogue table.
body.grammar: '것을' nominalizes the preceding clause. '긍정적으로' is an adverb meaning 'positively'.

body.text: 회의가 끝난 후 좌파당 측은 기존 입장에 변화가 없다고 밝혔어요.
body.en: After the meeting ended, the Left Party side stated that there was no change to their existing stance.
body.grammar: 'ㄴ/은 후' means 'after doing'. The indirect quotation marker '다고' is embedded in '밝혔어요' (stated that).

body.text: 좌파당은 모든 유권자의 표가 동등하게 존중되어야 한다고 강조하고 있어요.
body.en: The Left Party is emphasizing that the votes of all voters must be respected equally.
body.grammar: '동등하게' is an adverb meaning 'equally'. '존중되어야 한다고' combines passive voice, obligation ('어야 한다'), and quotation ('다고').

title.text: S och V i nytt möte för att diskutera regeringsfrågan
title.en: S and V in a new meeting to discuss the government issue
title.grammar: Abbreviations 'S' and 'V' stand for the parties. 'För att' is followed by the infinitive 'diskutera' to express purpose.

body.text: Socialdemokraternas partiledare Magdalena Andersson och Vänsterpartiets ledare Nooshi Dadgostar träffades på måndagsförmiddagen.
body.en: Social Democratic party leader Magdalena Andersson and Left Party leader Nooshi Dadgostar met on Monday morning.
body.grammar: Compound nouns like 'partiledare' and 'måndagsförmiddagen' combine two base words into a single definite/indefinite form.

body.text: Mötet hölls i riksdagskansliet och varade i ungefär två timmar för att diskutera regeringsfrågan.
body.en: The meeting was held in the parliamentary office and lasted for about two hours to discuss the government issue.
body.grammar: 'Hölls' is the passive past tense of 'hålla'. 'Varade' is the past tense of 'vara' (to last).

body.text: Målet för Socialdemokraterna är att få Vänsterpartiet att backa från sitt krav på ministerposter.
body.en: The goal for the Social Democrats is to get the Left Party to back down from its demand for ministerial posts.
body.grammar: The phrasal verb 'att backa från' means 'to back down from'. 'Sitt' is a reflexive possessive pronoun referring back to the subject.

body.text: Låsningen mellan partierna ligger dock kvar efter mötet.
body.en: However, the deadlock between the parties remains after the meeting.
body.grammar: 'Dock' means 'however'. 'Ligger kvar' is a particle verb construction meaning 'remains' or 'stays behind'.

body.text: Efter att Centerpartiet ställt sig bakom Socialdemokraternas förslag sitter nu alla fyra rödgröna partier vid förhandlingsbordet.
body.en: After the Center Party backed the Social Democrats' proposal, all four red-green parties are now sitting at the negotiating table.
body.grammar: 'Efter att' is followed by the past participle 'ställt sig bakom' (backed/stood behind). Note V2 word order after the initial time clause: 'sitter nu alla fyra...' puts the verb 'sitter' in second position.

body.text: Socialdemokraterna beskriver det som väldigt positivt att alla parter pratar med varandra.
